    /**
     * {@code "race_calendar": [{"round": 18, "name": "United States Grand Prix", "place": "Austin",
     * "sessions": [{"name": "FP1", "start": "2026-10-23T17:30:00Z"}, ...]}, ...]}. A race or session that does
     * not parse is left out on its own; the rest of the calendar still counts.
     */
    private static List<RaceWeekend.Race> raceCalendar(JSONObject json) {
        List<RaceWeekend.Race> races = new ArrayList<>();
        JSONArray list = json.optJSONArray("race_calendar");
        if (list == null) return races;
        for (int i = 0; i < list.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject r = list.optJSONObject(i);
            JSONArray sessions = r == null ? null : r.optJSONArray("sessions");
            if (sessions == null) continue;
            List<RaceWeekend.Session> parsed = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < sessions.length(); j++) {
                JSONObject s = sessions.optJSONObject(j);
                if (s == null) continue;
                String name = s.optString("name", "").trim();
                try {
                    if (!name.isEmpty()) parsed.add(new RaceWeekend.Session(name, java.time.Instant.parse(s.optString("start", ""))));
                } catch (java.time.format.DateTimeParseException ignored) {
                    // a session without a readable start time cannot be counted down
                }
            }
            if (!parsed.isEmpty()) races.add(new RaceWeekend.Race(r.optInt("round", 0),
                    r.optString("name", "Grand Prix").trim(), r.optString("place", "").trim(), parsed));
        }
        return races;
    }

    private static void syncThemeChoices(SharedPreferences choices, File dir, File config) {
        File revision = dir == null ? null : new File(dir, THEME_REVISION_NAME);
        String token = revisionToken(revision);
        String signature = fileStamp(config) + ":" + token;
        String seen = choices.getString(THEME_SIGNATURE_KEY, null);
        if (seen == null) {
            // Existing preferences survive an app upgrade, unless the first launch follows an
            // explicit theme push or reset by the updated tools.
            SharedPreferences.Editor editor = choices.edit();
            if (!"absent".equals(token)) editor.remove("columns").remove("animations")
                    .remove("advanced_effects").remove(ROWS_BELOW_DOCK_KEY).remove(WALLPAPER_CHOICE_KEY)
                    .remove(DOCK_OPACITY_KEY).remove(CLOCK_FORMAT_KEY);
            editor.putString(THEME_SIGNATURE_KEY, signature).commit();
        } else if (!seen.equals(signature)) {
            choices.edit().remove("columns").remove("animations").remove("advanced_effects")
                    .remove(ROWS_BELOW_DOCK_KEY).remove(WALLPAPER_CHOICE_KEY).remove(DOCK_OPACITY_KEY)
                    .remove(CLOCK_FORMAT_KEY).putString(THEME_SIGNATURE_KEY, signature).commit();
        }
    }

    /** The dock band opacity chosen in Launcher settings, or the theme's when none (or an out-of-range one) is saved. */
    static int chosenDockOpacity(int chosen, int theme) {
        return chosen >= 30 && chosen <= 100 ? chosen : theme;
    }

    private static String fileStamp(File file) {
        return file != null && file.isFile() ? file.length() + "@" + file.lastModified() : "absent";
    }

    private static String revisionToken(File file) {
        if (file == null || !file.isFile() || file.length() > 64) return "absent";
        try (InputStream in = new FileInputStream(file)) {
            byte[] bytes = new byte[(int) file.length()];
            int n = in.read(bytes);
            return n > 0 ? new String(bytes, 0, n, StandardCharsets.US_ASCII) : "absent";
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return "absent";
        }
    }

    /** Reads and parses the overlay; any problem means "no overlay", never a crash on the home screen. */
    /**
     * The overlay, or before external storage is mounted, the copy kept from the last time it was read. Home can
     * start before the card is mounted (seen at every boot on a Xiaomi MiTV-MTEQ0), and without the copy it comes
     * up with the built-in dock order. A missing file on mounted storage still means no overlay.
     */
    private static JSONObject readOverlay(Context ctx, File file, boolean mounted) {
        File copy = new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), FILE_NAME);
        if (!mounted) return read(copy);
        JSONObject json = read(file);
        if (json == null) {
            copy.delete();
        } else {
            try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(copy)) {
                out.write(json.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            } catch (IOException e) {
                Log.w(TAG, "could not keep a copy of " + file + ": " + e.getMessage());
            }
        }
        return json;
    }

    private static JSONObject read(File file) {
        if (file == null || !file.isFile()) return null;
        if (file.length() > 64 * 1024) {
            Log.w(TAG, "ignoring " + file + ": larger than 64 KB");
            return null;
        }
        try (InputStream in = new FileInputStream(file)) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[(int) file.length()];
            int n = 0, r;
            while (n < buf.length && (r = in.read(buf, n, buf.length - n)) > 0) n += r;
            String text = new String(buf, 0, n, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            if (text.startsWith("\uFEFF")) text = text.substring(1);   // Windows editors add a BOM
            return new JSONObject(text);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.w(TAG, "ignoring " + file + ": " + e.getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** wallpaper_moods as JSON text (config.xml); empty or unreadable is no groups. */
    private static Map<String, Set<String>> moods(String text) {
        if (text.trim().isEmpty()) return Collections.emptyMap();
        try {
            return moods(new JSONObject(text));
        } catch (JSONException e) {
            return Collections.emptyMap();
        }
    }

    /** {"night": ["03-moon-lake.jpg", ...], ...}: each mood's picture names; other keys and names are left out. */
    private static Map<String, Set<String>> moods(JSONObject o) {
        Map<String, Set<String>> groups = new HashMap<>();
        for (String mood : WallpaperMood.ALL) {
            JSONArray names = o.optJSONArray(mood);
            if (names == null) continue;
            Set<String> group = new HashSet<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < names.length(); i++) {
                String name = names.optString(i, "").trim();
                if (ThemeFiles.collectionImage(name)) group.add(name);
            }
            if (!group.isEmpty()) groups.put(mood, Collections.unmodifiableSet(group));
        }
        return Collections.unmodifiableMap(groups);
    }

    private static String string(JSONObject o, String key, String fallback) {
        Object v = o.opt(key);
        return v instanceof String ? ((String) v).trim() : fallback;
    }

    /** The theme's festival: {@code festival}, or {@code seasonal_skin} when that is empty or missing. */
    static String festivalName(JSONObject o) {
        String name = string(o, "festival", "");
        return name.isEmpty() ? string(o, "seasonal_skin", "") : name;
    }

    private static boolean bool(JSONObject o, String key, boolean fallback) {
        Object v = o.opt(key);
        return v instanceof Boolean ? (Boolean) v : fallback;
    }

    private static int integer(JSONObject o, String key, int fallback, int min, int max) {
        Object v = o.opt(key);
        if (!(v instanceof Number)) return fallback;
        int i = ((Number) v).intValue();
        return i < min || i > max ? fallback : i;
    }

    private static int color(JSONObject o, String key, int fallback) {
        Object v = o.opt(key);
        if (!(v instanceof String)) return fallback;
        try {
            int c = Color.parseColor(((String) v).trim());
            return c | 0xFF000000;   // always opaque: the window behind is black anyway
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    /** Positive keycodes only (vendor remotes use codes in the thousands); a list with anything else in it is ignored as a whole. */
    private static int[] intArray(JSONObject o, String key, int[] fallback) {
        Object v = o.opt(key);
        if (!(v instanceof JSONArray)) return fallback;
        JSONArray a = (JSONArray) v;
        int[] out = new int[a.length()];
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length(); i++) {
            Object item = a.opt(i);
            if (!(item instanceof Number)) return fallback;
            out[i] = ((Number) item).intValue();
            if (out[i] < 1) return fallback;
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** "package=value" entries; an entry without both halves is skipped, and a later entry for a package wins. */
    static Map<String, String> packageMap(List<String> entries) {
        Map<String, String> out = new HashMap<>();
        for (String entry : entries) {
            int eq = entry.indexOf('=');
            if (eq <= 0) continue;
            String pkg = entry.substring(0, eq).trim(), value = entry.substring(eq + 1).trim();
            if (!pkg.isEmpty() && !value.isEmpty()) out.put(pkg, value);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static List<String> stringList(JSONObject o, String key, List<String> fallback) {
        Object v = o.opt(key);
        if (!(v instanceof JSONArray)) return fallback;
        JSONArray a = (JSONArray) v;
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length(); i++) {
            Object item = a.opt(i);
            if (item instanceof String && !((String) item).trim().isEmpty()) out.add(((String) item).trim());
        }
        return out;
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.Context;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Inputs on Coocaa OS (Skyworth) TVs, which register nothing with TvInputManager. com.skyworth.tv lists
 * the sources its own Source panel shows (HDMI 1, HDMI 2, RF, AV), and switches to one and brings up its
 * player, as picking it in that panel does.
 */
final class CoocaaSources {

    private static final Uri LIST = Uri.parse("content://com.skyworth.tv.provider/system/source_list");
    private static final Uri METHOD = Uri.parse("content://com.skyworth.tv.sdk.provider/method");
    private static final String[] COLUMNS = {"sourceName", "sourceIndex", "displayName"};

    static final class Source {
        /** HDMI, AV, VOD (the RF tuner), ... */
        final String name;
        final int index;
        final String label;

        Source(String name, int index, String label) {
            this.name = name;
            this.index = index;
            this.label = label;
        }
    }

    private CoocaaSources() {
    }

    /** HDMI ports in port order, then AV, then the tuner; empty where the provider is missing. */
    static List<Source> list(Context ctx) {
        List<Source> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Cursor c = ctx.getContentResolver().query(LIST, COLUMNS, null, null, null)) {
            while (c != null && c.moveToNext()) {
                String name = c.getString(0);
                String label = c.getString(2);
                if (name == null) continue;
                out.add(new Source(name, c.getInt(1), label == null || label.isEmpty() ? name : label));
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }
        Collections.sort(out, (a, b) -> a.name.equals(b.name) ? Integer.compare(a.index, b.index)
                : Integer.compare(rank(a.name), rank(b.name)));
        return out;
    }

    private static int rank(String name) {
        switch (name) {
            case "HDMI": return 0;
            case "AV": return 1;
            case "VOD": return 3;
            default: return 2;
        }
    }

    static boolean open(Context ctx, Source source) {
        Bundle extras = new Bundle();
        extras.putString("name", source.name);
        extras.putInt("index", source.index);
        try {
            Bundle ret = ctx.getContentResolver().call(METHOD, "METHOD_GOTO_SOURCE", null, extras);
            return ret != null && ret.getBoolean("ret");
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

/**
 * A clay diya whose flame shows the network: the flame's height follows the signal level (1 to 4), it goes out
 * with a wisp of smoke when the level drops to 0, and relights with a spark when it comes back. Ethernet gets a
 * calm, steady flame. Drawn in a 24 x 24 unit box scaled into the bounds, with a dark outline so it reads on the
 * frosted and on the white (focused) pill. The flame flickers only while started, at about 15 fps; nothing is
 * allocated per frame. The first {@link #setFlame} call applies its level without an animation.
 */
public final class DiyaDrawable extends Drawable implements FestiveLamp {

    private static final float BOX = 24f;
    private static final long FRAME_MS = 66;
    private static final long LEVEL_MS = 300, OUT_MS = 350, SMOKE_DELAY_MS = 260, SMOKE_MS = 900;
    private static final long OUT_END_MS = Math.max(OUT_MS, SMOKE_DELAY_MS + SMOKE_MS);
    private static final long SPARK_MS = 200, GROW_DELAY_MS = 110, GROW_MS = 500;
    private static final int IDLE = 0, OUT = 1, RELIGHT = 2;
    /** Flame size for each level; index 0 is out. */
    private static final float[] LEVEL_SCALE = {0f, 0.46f, 0.64f, 0.82f, 1f};
    /** Where the flame stands: the wick at the tip of the spout. */
    private static final float WICK_X = 18.5f, WICK_Y = 12.1f;
    /** Full flame height and half width, in box units. */
    private static final float FLAME_H = 10f, FLAME_W = 2f;
    private static final int SMOKE_POINTS = 16;
    /** Painted dots on the bowl, x/y pairs. */
    private static final float[] DOTS = {5.0f, 17.6f, 7.4f, 18.5f, 9.9f, 18.8f, 12.4f, 18.4f, 14.6f, 17.3f};

    private final float density;
    private final float[] noise = new float[256];

    private final Path body = new Path(), opening = new Path(), rimLip = new Path(), sheen = new Path();
    private final Path flame = new Path(), core = new Path(), smoke = new Path();
    private final RectF foot = new RectF(7.2f, 20.0f, 12.4f, 22.4f);
    private final RectF oval = new RectF();
    private final Matrix matrix = new Matrix();

    private final Paint footPaint, bodyPaint, warmPaint, openingPaint, openingEdge, dotPaint, lipPaint, sheenPaint,
            outlinePaint, wickPaint, glowPaint, flamePaint, edgePaint, corePaint, smokePaint, emberPaint, sparkPaint,
            rayPaint;
    private final Paint[] paints;
    private final Shader glowShader, flameShader, coreShader, smokeShader, sparkShader;

    private int level = 4;
    private boolean primed;
    private float scaleFrom = 1f, scaleTo = 1f;
    private long scaleStart;
    private int phase = IDLE;
    private long phaseStart;
    private float outFrom;
    private boolean running, steady, reduced;
    private int alpha = 255;
    private final long epoch = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();

    private final Runnable tick = new Runnable() {
        @Override
        public void run() {
            long now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
            update(now);
            invalidateSelf();
            if (wantsFrames()) scheduleSelf(this, now + FRAME_MS);
        }
    };

    public DiyaDrawable(float density) {
        this.density = density;
        Random rnd = new Random(0xD1A5L);
        for (int i = 0; i < noise.length; i++) noise[i] = rnd.nextFloat() * 2f - 1f;
        buildLamp();

        footPaint = fill(0xFF8E3E1E);
        bodyPaint = fill(0xFFC4612F);
        bodyPaint.setShader(new RadialGradient(7.5f, 14.5f, 13f,
                new int[]{0xFFE58C57, 0xFFC4612F, 0xFF9A4220, 0xFF6E2C14},
                new float[]{0f, 0.35f, 0.7f, 1f}, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
        warmPaint = fill(0xFFFFB347);
        RadialGradient warm = new RadialGradient(0f, 0f, 1f,
                new int[]{0xA6FFB347, 0x40FF9A2A, 0x00FF8A1A}, new float[]{0f, 0.5f, 1f}, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP);
        matrix.setScale(9f, 9f);
        matrix.postTranslate(WICK_X, WICK_Y);
        warm.setLocalMatrix(matrix);
        warmPaint.setShader(warm);
        openingPaint = fill(0xFF4A1E0E);
        openingPaint.setShader(new LinearGradient(2.6f, 0f, 19f, 0f,
                new int[]{0xFF3B170A, 0xFF5A2A10, 0xFF7A4416}, null, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
        openingEdge = stroke(0xFF4A1A0A, 0.3f);
        dotPaint = fill(0xFFFFE0A3);
        lipPaint = stroke(0xFFEE9A68, 0.6f);
        sheenPaint = stroke(0x73FFE8D2, 0.75f);
        outlinePaint = stroke(0xFF3D1408, 0.7f);
        wickPaint = stroke(0xFF2B140A, 0.6f);

        glowPaint = fill(0xFFFFB040);
        glowShader = new RadialGradient(0f, 0f, 1f,
                new int[]{0x99FFC45A, 0x44FF9A2A, 0x00FF8A1A}, new float[]{0f, 0.45f, 1f}, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP);
        glowPaint.setShader(glowShader);
        flamePaint = fill(0xFFFF9A2A);
        flameShader = new LinearGradient(0f, 0f, 0f, 1f,
                new int[]{0xFFD9430B, 0xFFFF7A14, 0xFFFFA62B, 0xFFFFB83F, 0xFFF08A24},
                new float[]{0f, 0.22f, 0.55f, 0.85f, 1f}, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP);
        flamePaint.setShader(flameShader);
        edgePaint = stroke(0xFFB8400A, 0.28f);
        corePaint = fill(0xFFFFF0B8);
        coreShader = new LinearGradient(0f, 0f, 0f, 1f,
                new int[]{0xFFFFD25A, 0xFFFFF0B8, 0xFFFFF8E1, 0xFFFFE9A6},
                new float[]{0f, 0.35f, 0.7f, 1f}, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP);
        corePaint.setShader(coreShader);

        smokePaint = stroke(0xFFA0A0A0, 0.6f);
        smokeShader = new LinearGradient(0f, 0f, 0f, 1f,
                new int[]{0x00A0A0A0, 0xB09A9A9A, 0xFF8E8E8E}, new float[]{0f, 0.4f, 1f}, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP);
        smokePaint.setShader(smokeShader);
        emberPaint = fill(0xFFFF5A1A);
        sparkPaint = fill(0xFFFFF4C8);
        sparkShader = new RadialGradient(0f, 0f, 1f,
                new int[]{0xFFFFF4C8, 0xCCFFC24A, 0x00FF9A20}, new float[]{0f, 0.45f, 1f}, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP);
        sparkPaint.setShader(sparkShader);
        rayPaint = stroke(0xFFF2A12E, 0.35f);

        paints = new Paint[]{footPaint, bodyPaint, warmPaint, openingPaint, openingEdge, dotPaint, lipPaint,
                sheenPaint, outlinePaint, wickPaint, glowPaint, flamePaint, edgePaint, corePaint, smokePaint,
                emberPaint, sparkPaint, rayPaint};
    }

    // ---- public API ----

    /** 0 puts the flame out; 1 to 4 is the signal strength, which sets the flame's height. */
    @Override
    public void setFlame(int newLevel) {
        int lvl = Math.max(0, Math.min(4, newLevel));
        if (!primed) {
            primed = true;
            level = lvl;
            snap();
            kick();
            return;
        }
        if (lvl == level) return;
        long now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        update(now);
        float current = flameScale(now);
        int old = level;
        level = lvl;
        if (!animates()) {
            snap();
        } else if (lvl == 0) {
            outFrom = current;
            phase = OUT;
            phaseStart = now;
        } else if (old == 0) {
            phase = RELIGHT;
            phaseStart = now;
            scaleFrom = scaleTo = LEVEL_SCALE[lvl];
            scaleStart = now;
        } else {
            scaleFrom = baseScale(now);
            scaleTo = LEVEL_SCALE[lvl];
            scaleStart = now;
        }
        kick();
    }

    /** A steady flame (Ethernet) only breathes slowly and does not sway. */
    @Override
    public void setSteady(boolean steady) {
        if (this.steady == steady) return;
        this.steady = steady;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    /** With reduced motion the flame is still, there is no smoke or spark, and level changes are instant. */
    @Override
    public void setReducedMotion(boolean reducedMotion) {
        if (reduced == reducedMotion) return;
        reduced = reducedMotion;
        if (reduced) snap();
        kick();
    }

    @Override
    public void start() {
        if (running) return;
        running = true;
        kick();
    }

    @Override
    public void stop() {
        if (!running) return;
        running = false;
        snap();
        kick();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isRunning() {
        return running;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean setVisible(boolean visible, boolean restart) {
        boolean changed = super.setVisible(visible, restart);
        if (changed) {
            if (!visible) snap();
            kick();
        }
        return changed;
    }

    // ---- state ----

    private boolean animates() {
        return running && !reduced && isVisible();
    }

    private boolean wantsFrames() {
        return running && isVisible() && ((level > 0 && !reduced) || phase != IDLE);
    }

    private void kick() {
        unscheduleSelf(tick);
        if (wantsFrames()) scheduleSelf(tick, SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + FRAME_MS);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    /** Jumps to the end state of whatever is playing. */
    private void snap() {
        phase = IDLE;
        scaleFrom = scaleTo = LEVEL_SCALE[level];
    }

    private void update(long now) {
        if (phase == OUT && now - phaseStart >= OUT_END_MS) phase = IDLE;
        else if (phase == RELIGHT && now - phaseStart >= GROW_DELAY_MS + GROW_MS) phase = IDLE;
    }

    private float baseScale(long now) {
        float p = clamp01((now - scaleStart) / (float) LEVEL_MS);
        return scaleFrom + (scaleTo - scaleFrom) * decel(p);
    }

    private float flameScale(long now) {
        switch (phase) {
            case OUT: {
                float e = (now - phaseStart) / (float) OUT_MS;
                return e >= 1f ? 0f : outFrom * (1f - e * e);
            }
            case RELIGHT: {
                float g = (now - phaseStart - GROW_DELAY_MS) / (float) GROW_MS;
                return g <= 0f ? 0f : baseScale(now) * backOut(Math.min(1f, g));
            }
            default:
                return level == 0 ? 0f : baseScale(now);
        }
    }

    private float flameBright(long now) {
        if (phase != OUT) return 1f;
        float e = clamp01((now - phaseStart) / (float) OUT_MS);
        return 1f - e * (float) Math.sqrt(e);
    }

    // ---- drawing ----

    @Override
    public void draw(@NonNull Canvas c) {
        Rect b = getBounds();
        if (b.isEmpty()) return;
        long now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        update(now);
        float s = Math.min(b.width(), b.height()) / BOX;
        int save = alpha < 255 ? c.saveLayerAlpha(b.left, b.top, b.right, b.bottom, alpha) : c.save();
        c.clipRect(b);
        c.translate(b.exactCenterX() - 12f * s, b.exactCenterY() - 12f * s);
        c.scale(s, s);

        float scale = flameScale(now);
        float bright = flameBright(now);
        float hMul = 1f, wMul = 1f, sway = 0f;
        if (running && !reduced && isVisible()) {
            float t = (now - epoch) / 1000f;
            if (steady) {
                float breath = sin(t / 4.2f);
                hMul = 1f + 0.035f * breath;
                wMul = 1f + 0.02f * breath;
            } else {
                hMul = 1f + 0.055f * sin(0.83f * t) + 0.035f * sin(1.71f * t + 0.21f)
                        + 0.025f * sin(2.63f * t + 0.33f) + 0.03f * noise(t * 1.9f);
                wMul = 1f + 0.045f * sin(1.37f * t + 0.14f) + 0.03f * noise(t * 2.2f + 31f);
                sway = 0.45f * sin(0.47f * t + 0.1f) + 0.28f * sin(1.13f * t + 0.38f) + 0.2f * noise(t * 1.3f + 17f);
            }
        }
        float h = FLAME_H * scale * hMul;
        float w = FLAME_W * Math.min(1f, scale * 2.2f) * (0.5f + 0.5f * scale) * wMul;
        float lean = sway * scale;
        float vis = scale * bright;

        if (vis > 0.01f) {
            float cx = WICK_X + lean * 0.4f, cy = WICK_Y - h * 0.45f;
            float rx = 2.6f + 3.4f * scale, ry = rx * 1.2f;
            matrix.setScale(rx, ry);
            matrix.postTranslate(cx, cy);
            glowShader.setLocalMatrix(matrix);
            glowPaint.setAlpha((int) (255 * bright * (0.5f + 0.5f * scale)));
            oval.set(cx - rx, cy - ry, cx + rx, cy + ry);
            c.drawOval(oval, glowPaint);
        }

        drawLamp(c, vis);

        if (phase == OUT) drawSmoke(c, now);
        if (phase == RELIGHT) drawSpark(c, now);

        if (h > 0.15f && bright > 0.01f) {
            float by = WICK_Y + 0.2f;
            teardrop(flame, WICK_X, by, h, w, lean);
            matrix.setScale(1f, h);
            matrix.postTranslate(0f, by - h);
            flameShader.setLocalMatrix(matrix);
            flamePaint.setAlpha((int) (255 * bright));
            c.drawPath(flame, flamePaint);
            edgePaint.setAlpha((int) (150 * bright));
            c.drawPath(flame, edgePaint);

            float cby = WICK_Y - h * 0.06f, ch = h * 0.58f, cw = w * 0.5f;
            teardrop(core, WICK_X + lean * 0.05f, cby, ch, cw, lean * 0.55f);
            matrix.setScale(1f, ch);
            matrix.postTranslate(0f, cby - ch);
            coreShader.setLocalMatrix(matrix);
            corePaint.setAlpha((int) (255 * bright * bright));
            c.drawPath(core, corePaint);
        }
        c.restoreToCount(save);
    }

    private void drawLamp(Canvas c, float warmth) {
        c.drawOval(foot, footPaint);
        c.drawOval(foot, outlinePaint);
        c.drawPath(body, bodyPaint);
        if (warmth > 0.01f) {
            warmPaint.setAlpha((int) (190 * warmth));
            c.drawPath(body, warmPaint);
        }
        c.drawPath(opening, openingPaint);
        if (warmth > 0.01f) {
            warmPaint.setAlpha((int) (255 * warmth));
            c.drawPath(opening, warmPaint);
        }
        c.drawPath(opening, openingEdge);
        for (int i = 0; i < DOTS.length; i += 2) c.drawCircle(DOTS[i], DOTS[i + 1], 0.42f, dotPaint);
        c.drawPath(rimLip, lipPaint);
        c.drawPath(sheen, sheenPaint);
        c.drawPath(body, outlinePaint);
        c.drawLine(WICK_X - 0.9f, WICK_Y + 0.7f, WICK_X, WICK_Y, wickPaint);
    }

    private void drawSmoke(Canvas c, long now) {
        long since = now - phaseStart;
        // the wick glows for a moment after the flame dies
        float ember = 1f - since / (float) (SMOKE_DELAY_MS + SMOKE_MS * 0.6f);
        if (ember > 0f) {
            emberPaint.setAlpha((int) (255 * ember));
            c.drawCircle(WICK_X, WICK_Y, 0.5f, emberPaint);
        }
        if (reduced) return;
        float sp = (since - SMOKE_DELAY_MS) / (float) SMOKE_MS;
        if (sp <= 0f || sp >= 1f) return;
        float head = 10.5f * decel(sp);
        float tp = (sp - 0.3f) / 0.7f;
        float tail = tp <= 0f ? 0f : Math.min(head - 0.6f, 8.5f * tp * tp);
        if (head - tail < 0.3f) return;
        smoke.reset();
        for (int i = 0; i < SMOKE_POINTS; i++) {
            float d = tail + (head - tail) * i / (SMOKE_POINTS - 1);
            float curl = (0.2f + 0.17f * d) * (float) Math.sin(d * 0.9f - sp * 5.5f);
            float x = WICK_X - 0.28f * d + curl, y = WICK_Y - 0.3f - d;
            if (i == 0) smoke.moveTo(x, y);
            else smoke.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        float top = WICK_Y - 0.3f - head;
        matrix.setScale(1f, head - tail);
        matrix.postTranslate(0f, top);
        smokeShader.setLocalMatrix(matrix);
        smokePaint.setStrokeWidth(0.55f + 0.35f * sp);
        smokePaint.setAlpha((int) (230 * (1f - sp)));
        c.drawPath(smoke, smokePaint);
    }

    private void drawSpark(Canvas c, long now) {
        float k = (now - phaseStart) / (float) SPARK_MS;
        if (k >= 1.5f) return;
        float r = 0.5f + 2.8f * decel(Math.min(1f, k));
        float a = k < 0.25f ? k / 0.25f : 1f - (k - 0.25f) / 1.25f;
        float cx = WICK_X, cy = WICK_Y - 0.5f;
        matrix.setScale(r, r);
        matrix.postTranslate(cx, cy);
        sparkShader.setLocalMatrix(matrix);
        sparkPaint.setAlpha((int) (255 * a));
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r, sparkPaint);
        rayPaint.setAlpha((int) (255 * a));
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            double ang = Math.toRadians(45 + 90 * i + 30 * k);
            float cs = (float) Math.cos(ang), sn = (float) Math.sin(ang);
            c.drawLine(cx + cs * r * 0.55f, cy + sn * r * 0.55f, cx + cs * r * 1.15f, cy + sn * r * 1.15f, rayPaint);
        }
    }

    /** A candle-flame teardrop standing on (bx, by): round bulb low down, pointed tip leaning by {@code lean}. */
    private static void teardrop(Path p, float bx, float by, float h, float w, float lean) {
        float tx = bx + lean, ty = by - h;
        float ml = lean * 0.35f;
        float wy = by - Math.max(w * 1.1f, h * 0.24f);
        float up = (wy - ty) * 0.35f, down = (by - wy) * 0.55f;
        p.reset();
        p.moveTo(tx, ty);
        p.cubicTo(tx + w * 0.25f, ty + h * 0.3f, bx + ml + w, wy - up, bx + w, wy);
        p.cubicTo(bx + w, wy + down, bx + w * 0.55f, by, bx, by);
        p.cubicTo(bx - w * 0.55f, by, bx - w, wy + down, bx - w, wy);
        p.cubicTo(bx + ml - w, wy - up, tx - w * 0.25f, ty + h * 0.3f, tx, ty);
        p.close();
    }

    private void buildLamp() {
        body.moveTo(1.6f, 14.2f);
        body.cubicTo(1.8f, 18.6f, 5.4f, 21.0f, 9.6f, 21.0f);
        body.cubicTo(13.2f, 21.0f, 15.6f, 19.4f, 16.8f, 16.6f);
        body.cubicTo(17.6f, 15.0f, 18.6f, 13.6f, 20.2f, 12.4f);
        body.quadTo(20.5f, 12.0f, 19.9f, 11.9f);
        body.cubicTo(18.2f, 12.1f, 16.8f, 12.6f, 15.4f, 13.0f);
        body.cubicTo(12.0f, 11.6f, 5.0f, 11.8f, 1.6f, 14.2f);
        body.close();

        opening.moveTo(2.6f, 14.2f);
        opening.cubicTo(5.6f, 12.6f, 11.8f, 12.5f, 15.2f, 13.4f);
        opening.cubicTo(16.6f, 13.0f, 17.8f, 12.7f, 19.2f, 12.4f);
        opening.cubicTo(17.6f, 13.4f, 16.6f, 14.0f, 15.4f, 14.6f);
        opening.cubicTo(11.6f, 16.4f, 5.0f, 16.2f, 2.6f, 14.2f);
        opening.close();

        rimLip.moveTo(2.7f, 14.65f);
        rimLip.cubicTo(5.1f, 16.65f, 11.6f, 16.85f, 15.5f, 15.0f);
        rimLip.cubicTo(16.7f, 14.4f, 17.7f, 13.8f, 19.4f, 12.75f);

        sheen.moveTo(3.2f, 15.4f);
        sheen.quadTo(4.0f, 18.4f, 6.9f, 19.7f);
    }

    // ---- helpers ----

    private float noise(float x) {
        int i = (int) Math.floor(x);
        float f = x - i;
        float s = f * f * (3f - 2f * f);
        float a = noise[i & 255], b = noise[(i + 1) & 255];
        return a + (b - a) * s;
    }

    /** sin of a phase given in turns. */
    private static float sin(float turns) {
        return (float) Math.sin(turns * 2.0 * Math.PI);
    }

    private static float clamp01(float v) {
        return v < 0f ? 0f : (v > 1f ? 1f : v);
    }

    private static float decel(float p) {
        float q = 1f - p;
        return 1f - q * q;
    }

    private static float backOut(float x) {
        float s = 1.4f, q = x - 1f;
        return 1f + (s + 1f) * q * q * q + s * q * q;
    }

    private static Paint fill(int color) {
        Paint p = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
        p.setColor(color);
        return p;
    }

    private static Paint stroke(int color, float width) {
        Paint p = fill(color);
        p.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        p.setStrokeWidth(width);
        p.setStrokeCap(Paint.Cap.ROUND);
        p.setStrokeJoin(Paint.Join.ROUND);
        return p;
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicWidth() {
        return Math.round(BOX * density);
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicHeight() {
        return Math.round(BOX * density);
    }

    @Override
    public void setAlpha(int alpha) {
        if (this.alpha == alpha) return;
        this.alpha = alpha;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public int getAlpha() {
        return alpha;
    }

    @Override
    public void setColorFilter(@Nullable ColorFilter filter) {
        for (Paint p : paints) p.setColorFilter(filter);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
    public int getOpacity() {
        return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;
    }
}

/** Draws the tvOS style lighter band behind the first (dock) row and adds a gap below it. */
public class DockDecoration extends RecyclerView.ItemDecoration {

    private final int dockSize;
    private final float density;
    private final Paint band = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint edge = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final RectF rect = new RectF();

    /** Extra band below the tiles for their names (always_show_names), in px. */
    private final float namesRoom;
    /** Light glass like the top bar's pills (config.xml dock_glass): a white tint that fades downwards. */
    private final boolean lightGlass;
    /** Padding all round the tiles equal to the gap between them (config.xml dock_even_padding). */
    private final boolean evenPadding;
    /** The band's top and bottom the glass gradient was made for; it is remade when they move. */
    private float shaderTop = Float.NaN, shaderBottom = Float.NaN;
    /** Draw the band and its edge (config.xml dock_band); false leaves the tiles floating on the wallpaper. */
    private final boolean bandVisible;
    /** single_row: the tiles after the dock share its row, so they take the same offsets to stay level with it. */
    private final boolean singleRow;
    /** dock_band_all: in a single row, the band runs behind every app instead of the dock apps only. */
    private final boolean bandAll;

    /**
     * @param translucent the cinematic shelf's band: the artwork and the glow show through it.
     * @param names       the dock tiles show their names, so the band reaches down over them.
     * @param opacity     the plain band's opacity in percent (dock_opacity), so a wallpaper can show through it.
     * @param lightGlass  a light frosted band like the pills, for a sky or wallpaper behind it.
     * @param evenPadding the band's padding is the gap between the tiles on all four sides (dock_even_padding).
     * @param bandVisible false skips the band and its edge, so the tiles float on the wallpaper (dock_band).
     * @param singleRow   every app sits in the dock's row (single_row); the band covers the dock apps only, unless bandAll.
     * @param bandAll     with singleRow, the band runs behind every app in the row (dock_band_all).
     */
    DockDecoration(int dockSize, float density, boolean translucent, boolean names, int opacity, boolean lightGlass,
                   boolean evenPadding, boolean bandVisible, boolean singleRow, boolean bandAll) {
        this.dockSize = dockSize;
        this.singleRow = singleRow;
        this.bandAll = singleRow && bandAll;
        this.density = density;
        this.namesRoom = names ? 22 * density : 0;
        this.lightGlass = lightGlass;
        this.evenPadding = evenPadding;
        this.bandVisible = bandVisible;
        band.setColor(translucent ? 0x8C121014 : (Math.round(opacity * 2.55f) << 24) | 0x141416);
        edge.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        edge.setStrokeWidth(density);
        edge.setColor(lightGlass ? 0x38FFFFFF : translucent ? 0x26FFFFFF : 0x1FFFFFFF);
    }

    /** Concentric corners: the band's radius is the tiles' radius plus the band's padding around them. */
    static float radiusPx(float tileRadiusPx, float paddingPx) {
        return tileRadiusPx + paddingPx;
    }

    /**
     * The band's padding on every side for dock_even_padding: the gap between two dock tiles (a cell minus its tile, as
     * AppAdapter.tileWidthPx lays them out), capped by the room the grid leaves at its edges.
     */
    static float evenPaddingPx(int innerWidthPx, int columns, int tileWidthPx, float roomPx) {
        float gap = columns > 0 ? innerWidthPx / (float) columns - tileWidthPx : 0f;
        return Math.max(0f, Math.min(gap, roomPx));
    }

    @Override
    public void getItemOffsets(@NonNull Rect outRect, @NonNull View view, @NonNull RecyclerView parent,
                               @NonNull RecyclerView.State state) {
        int pos = parent.getChildAdapterPosition(view);
        if (pos >= 0 && (singleRow || pos < dockSize)) {
            outRect.top = (int) (6 * density);
            outRect.bottom = (int) (12 * density);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onDraw(@NonNull Canvas c, @NonNull RecyclerView parent, @NonNull RecyclerView.State state) {
        if (!bandVisible) return;
        boolean any = false;
        int cardWidth = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < parent.getChildCount(); i++) {
            View child = parent.getChildAt(i);
            int pos = parent.getChildAdapterPosition(child);
            if (pos < 0 || (!bandAll && pos >= dockSize)) continue;
            RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = parent.getChildViewHolder(child);
            View card = vh instanceof AppAdapter.Holder ? ((AppAdapter.Holder) vh).card : child.findViewById(R.id.card);
            if (card == null) continue;
            float l = child.getLeft() + card.getLeft();
            float t = child.getTop() + card.getTop() + child.getTranslationY();
            float r = l + card.getWidth();
            float b = t + card.getHeight();
            cardWidth = card.getWidth();
            if (!any) {
                rect.set(l, t, r, b);
                any = true;
            } else {
                rect.union(l, t, r, b);
            }
        }
        if (!any) return;
        float pad = 14 * density;
        // The band can only draw inside the grid, and the first and last dock tiles sit 12dp in from its
        // edges: a full 14dp at the sides sliced the rounded ends flat (#454). Keep the sides, with the
        // 1dp edge line, inside the grid; the top and bottom have room.
        // 22dp at the sides (the grid's 10dp padding makes room): a focused first or last tile grows about 7dp
        // outwards and still keeps about the band's top margin from its rounded end.
        float sidePad = 22 * density;
        float side = Math.max(0f, Math.min(sidePad, Math.min(rect.left, parent.getWidth() - rect.right) - density));
        float radius = AppAdapter.cornerRadius(cardWidth, density);
        if (evenPadding) {
            // The same padding on all four sides, so the band's corners are concentric with the tiles' everywhere.
            int inner = parent.getWidth() - parent.getPaddingLeft() - parent.getPaddingRight();
            // A single row's tiles can run off the screen, so only its top limits the padding; its ends are clamped below.
            float room = (singleRow ? rect.top : Math.min(rect.top, Math.min(rect.left, parent.getWidth() - rect.right))) - density;
            float even = evenPaddingPx(inner, dockSize, cardWidth, room);
            rect.inset(-even, -even);
            radius = radiusPx(radius, even);
        } else {
            // dock_even_padding off: the band as before, with its fixed 26 dp corners.
            rect.inset(singleRow ? -sidePad : -side, -pad);
            radius = 26 * density;
        }
        if (singleRow) {
            // Tiles past the screen's edge: the band stops at the grid's edge with its rounded end instead of being
            // sliced square there.
            rect.left = Math.max(rect.left, density);
            rect.right = Math.min(rect.right, parent.getWidth() - density);
        }
        rect.bottom += namesRoom;
        if (lightGlass && (rect.top != shaderTop || rect.bottom != shaderBottom)) {
            // The pills' glass (pill_bg: white, 18% fading to 8%), a little fainter over this much larger area.
            band.setShader(new LinearGradient(0, rect.top, 0, rect.bottom, 0x24FFFFFF, 0x0DFFFFFF,
                    Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
            shaderTop = rect.top;
            shaderBottom = rect.bottom;
        }
        c.drawRoundRect(rect, radius, radius, band);
        c.drawRoundRect(rect, radius, radius, edge);
    }
}
`n`n========== FILE: launcher\app\src\main\java\com\gathin\tvhome\DockSlots.java ==========
package com.gathin.tvhome;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * The dock is the first row of the grid. dock_apps decides what is in it, or the saved order once the owner
 * changed the dock on the TV: a slot left free stays empty instead of taking the first grid app (#162) when
 * fill_dock is false; by default they fill.
 */
final class DockSlots {
    private DockSlots() { }

    /**
     * Empty slots to put after the {@code docked} dock apps found. None when the dock is full, when no
     * dock app is installed (the first row fills so Home still has a dock) or when nothing follows.
     */
    static int empty(int docked, int dockSize, int tiles, boolean fill) {
        if (fill || docked <= 0 || docked >= dockSize || tiles <= docked) return 0;
        return dockSize - docked;
    }

    /**
     * The order a reorder session saves when fill_dock is false (#499). Reorder mode shows no empty slots, so a
     * grid app slides into a free dock slot without being put there. Only the keys in {@code dock} (in the dock
     * when the session started, or carried into it) that end inside the first {@code dockSize} places stay in the
     * dock: they come first, in their order, and every other key follows in its order. The dock size to save is
     * the number of keys in {@code dock} found there.
     */
    static List<String> dockFirst(List<String> keys, int dockSize, Set<String> dock) {
        List<String> head = new ArrayList<>(), tail = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < keys.size(); i++) {
            String k = keys.get(i);
            (i < dockSize && dock.contains(k) ? head : tail).add(k);
        }
        head.addAll(tail);
        return head;
    }

    /** How many of the first {@code dockSize} keys are in {@code dock}: the dock size dockFirst puts first. */
    static int dockCount(List<String> keys, int dockSize, Set<String> dock) {
        int n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(dockSize, keys.size()); i++) if (dock.contains(keys.get(i))) n++;
        return n;
    }

    /** Whether a tile sits in the dock row: every tile of a single row, else the first `dockSize` of the grid. */
    static boolean inDockRow(boolean dockRow, boolean singleRow, int position, int dockSize) {
        return dockRow && (singleRow || position < dockSize);
    }

    /** A position focus can land on: an empty slot sends it to the last dock app. */
    static int focusable(int position, int docked, int empty) {
        return empty > 0 && position >= docked && position < docked + empty ? docked - 1 : position;
    }
}
`n`n========== FILE: launcher\app\src\main\java\com\gathin\tvhome\Festival.java ==========
package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.res.Resources;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * A festive skin set by a theme's config.json: {@code festival} (or {@code seasonal_skin}), {@code festival_until},
 * {@code greeting} and {@code accent_color}. While it is active the pills get festive icons (a diya for the
 * network, a bell for Inputs, a marigold for Settings; for {@code halloween} a jack-o'-lantern, a bat and a
 * ghost), the greeting is replaced and the focus glow takes the accent colour. It switches itself off after
 * {@code festival_until}, so nobody has to remember to undo it.
 */
final class Festival {

    static final Festival NONE = new Festival("", null, "", 0);

    /** Warm diya gold, the accent when a theme names a festival but no colour. */
    static final int DEFAULT_ACCENT = 0xFFFFB23C;

    /** The festival with its own skin (jack-o'-lantern, bat, ghost, bats on the first Home) instead of the diya's. */
    static final String HALLOWEEN = "halloween";

    /** Pumpkin orange, Halloween's accent when the theme names no colour. */
    static final int PUMPKIN = 0xFFFF7A1A;

    /** Lower-case festival name, or "" for none. */
    final String name;
    /** Last day the skin shows, inclusive; null for no end date. */
    final LocalDate until;
    /** Text that replaces the time-of-day greeting; "" uses the festival's own default. */
    final String greeting;
    /** Focus glow colour as 0xAARRGGBB, or 0 for {@link #DEFAULT_ACCENT}. */
    final int accent;

    private Festival(String name, LocalDate until, String greeting, int accent) {
        this.name = name;
        this.until = until;
        this.greeting = greeting;
        this.accent = accent;
    }

    /**
     * Builds the skin from raw config values. Anything malformed turns the skin off rather than leaving a
     * festival on the screen forever: an unreadable end date or an empty name gives {@link #NONE}.
     */
    static Festival parse(String name, String until, String greeting, String accent) {
        String n = name == null ? "" : name.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (n.isEmpty() || n.length() > 40) return NONE;
        LocalDate end = null;
        if (until != null && !until.trim().isEmpty()) {
            try {
                end = LocalDate.parse(until.trim());
            } catch (DateTimeParseException e) {
                return NONE;
            }
        }
        String g = greeting == null ? "" : Cards.cleanLabel(greeting, "");
        return new Festival(n, end, g, parseColor(accent));
    }

    /** Whether the skin shows today. */
    boolean active(LocalDate today) {
        return !name.isEmpty() && (until == null || !today.isAfter(until));
    }

    /** The greeting to show while active, or "" to keep the normal time-of-day greeting. */
    String greetingText(Resources res) {
        if (!greeting.isEmpty()) return greeting;
        switch (name) {
            case "dussehra":
                return res.getString(R.string.festival_dussehra_greeting);
            case "diwali":
                return res.getString(R.string.festival_diwali_greeting);
            case HALLOWEEN:
                return res.getString(R.string.festival_halloween_greeting);
            default:
                return "";
        }
    }

    int accentColor() {
        if (accent != 0) return accent;
        return isHalloween() ? PUMPKIN : DEFAULT_ACCENT;
    }

    /** Whether this is the Halloween skin rather than the diya, bell and marigold. */
    boolean isHalloween() {
        return HALLOWEEN.equals(name);
    }

    /** {@code #RRGGBB} to an opaque colour, anything else to 0. */
    static int parseColor(String s) {
        if (s == null) return 0;
        String t = s.trim();
        if (!t.matches("#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}")) return 0;
        return 0xFF000000 | Integer.parseInt(t.substring(1), 16);
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.ContentResolver;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.content.pm.ProviderInfo;
import android.database.ContentObserver;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Handler;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException;

/**
 * game_day (config.xml or a theme): each team's next game in the race panel's place, from an add-on such as
 * Game Day, rotating with the theme's F1 weekend. The launcher only reads what the add-on publishes and stays
 * offline. Contract: docs/modules.md.
 */
final class GameDay {
    static final String META = "com.gathin.tvhome.games";
    static final int TURN_DEFAULT = 30;
    private static final String[] COLUMNS = {"top_line", "word", "start_ms", "end_ms", "colour", "calendar", "turn_seconds"};

    private final Context ctx;
    private final Uri uri;
    private final Handler main;
    private final Runnable onChange;
    private final ExecutorService io = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final ContentObserver observer;
    private boolean watching;
    private List<Turn> turns = Collections.emptyList();
    private int turnSeconds = TURN_DEFAULT;

    private GameDay(Context ctx, Uri uri, Handler main, Runnable onChange) {
        this.ctx = ctx;
        this.uri = uri;
        this.main = main;
        this.onChange = onChange;
        observer = new ContentObserver(main) {
            @Override
            public void onChange(boolean selfChange) {
                read();
            }
        };
    }

    /**
     * Null when the key is empty, the package is not installed, or it names no provider of its own in a
     * {@value #META} meta-data. Naming the package is the owner's opt-in.
     */
    static GameDay create(Context ctx, String pkg, Handler main, Runnable onChange) {
        if (pkg == null || pkg.trim().isEmpty()) return null;
        try {
            PackageManager pm = ctx.getPackageManager();
            ApplicationInfo info = pm.getApplicationInfo(pkg.trim(), PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
            String authority = info.metaData == null ? null : info.metaData.getString(META);
            if (authority == null || authority.trim().isEmpty()) return null;
            // The provider must be the named package's own, not another app's that claims the authority.
            ProviderInfo provider = pm.resolveContentProvider(authority.trim(), 0);
            if (provider == null || !pkg.trim().equals(provider.packageName)) return null;
            Uri uri = new Uri.Builder().scheme(ContentResolver.SCHEME_CONTENT).authority(authority.trim()).appendPath("turns").build();
            return new GameDay(ctx, uri, main, onChange);
        } catch (PackageManager.NameNotFoundException e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** Home is on screen: read now and watch for changes. */
    void start() {
        if (!watching) {
            try {
                ctx.getContentResolver().registerContentObserver(uri, false, observer);
                watching = true;
            } catch (SecurityException e) {
                // The add-on's provider went away; the panel keeps what it had.
            }
        }
        read();
    }

    /** Home is off screen: nothing runs until it is back. */
    void stop() {
        if (watching) ctx.getContentResolver().unregisterContentObserver(observer);
        watching = false;
    }

    void shutdown() {
        stop();
        io.shutdownNow();
    }

    /** One query off the main thread (the provider lives in the add-on's process), then onChange on the main thread. */
    void read() {
        try {
            io.execute(() -> {
                List<Object[]> rows = new ArrayList<>();
                try (Cursor c = ctx.getContentResolver().query(uri, COLUMNS, null, null, null)) {
                    while (c != null && c.moveToNext()) {
                        rows.add(new Object[] {c.getString(0), c.getString(1), c.getLong(2), c.getLong(3), c.getInt(4),
                                c.getString(5), c.getInt(6)});
                    }
                } catch (RuntimeException gone) {
                    // Uninstalled or crashed mid-query: keep what is on screen.
                    return;
                }
                List<Turn> parsed = fromRows(rows);
                int seconds = turnSeconds(rows);
                main.post(() -> {
                    turns = parsed;
                    turnSeconds = seconds;
                    onChange.run();
                });
            });
        } catch (RejectedExecutionException shutDown) {
            // Home is being destroyed.
        }
    }

    List<Turn> turns() {
        return turns;
    }

    int turnSeconds() {
        return turnSeconds;
    }

    /** The add-on's rows as turns; a row without a top line or with impossible times is skipped. */
    static List<Turn> fromRows(List<Object[]> rows) {
        List<Turn> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Object[] r : rows) {
            if (!(r[0] instanceof String) || ((String) r[0]).isEmpty()) continue;
            long start = r[2] instanceof Number ? ((Number) r[2]).longValue() : -1;
            long end = r[3] instanceof Number ? ((Number) r[3]).longValue() : -1;
            if (start < 0 || end <= start) continue;
            String word = r[1] instanceof String ? (String) r[1] : "";
            int colour = r[4] instanceof Number ? ((Number) r[4]).intValue() : 0xFFFFFFFF;
            out.add(new Turn((String) r[0], word, start, end, colour));
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** 10 to 120 seconds per turn, as the add-on's settings allow; anything else is the default. */
    static int turnSeconds(List<Object[]> rows) {
        if (rows.isEmpty() || !(rows.get(0)[6] instanceof Number)) return TURN_DEFAULT;
        int s = ((Number) rows.get(0)[6]).intValue();
        return s >= 10 && s <= 120 ? s : TURN_DEFAULT;
    }

    /** One turn in the rotation: a game from the add-on, or the theme's F1 weekend ({@link #f1}). */
    static final class Turn {
        final String topLine;
        /** "Puck drop": the countdown reads "Puck drop in 2h 18m". */
        final String word;
        /** For the F1 turn: when its next session starts, or now while one is live (the sort key). */
        final long startMs;
        final long endMs;
        /** ARGB, for the short bar. */
        final int colour;
        final boolean f1;

        Turn(String topLine, String word, long startMs, long endMs, int colour) {
            this(topLine, word, startMs, endMs, colour, false);
        }

        private Turn(String topLine, String word, long startMs, long endMs, int colour, boolean f1) {
            this.topLine = topLine;
            this.word = word;
            this.startMs = startMs;
            this.endMs = endMs;
            this.colour = colour;
            this.f1 = f1;
        }
    }

    /**
     * The turns to rotate through, soonest first: the games that have not ended, and the F1 weekend as one turn
     * while the race panel would show it (sorted by its next session, or now while a session is live).
     */
    static List<Turn> merge(List<Turn> games, RaceWeekend.State f1, long nowMs) {
        List<Turn> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Turn t : games) {
            if (t.endMs > nowMs) out.add(t);
        }
        if (f1 != null) {
            long key = f1.live == null && f1.next != null ? f1.next.start.toEpochMilli() : nowMs;
            out.add(new Turn("", "", key, Long.MAX_VALUE, 0, true));
        }
        Collections.sort(out, Comparator.comparingLong(t -> t.startMs));
        return out;
    }

    /** Which turn is on screen, {@code sinceMs} after the rotation started. */
    static int current(int count, long sinceMs, int turnSeconds) {
        if (count <= 0) return 0;
        return (int) ((Math.max(0, sinceMs) / (turnSeconds * 1000L)) % count);
    }

    /** Milliseconds until the next turn, {@code sinceMs} after the rotation started. */
    static long delayToNextTurn(long sinceMs, int turnSeconds) {
        long turnMs = turnSeconds * 1000L;
        return turnMs - Math.floorMod(sinceMs, turnMs);
    }

    static boolean live(Turn t, long nowMs) {
        return nowMs >= t.startMs && nowMs < t.endMs;
    }

    static Duration until(Turn t, long nowMs) {
        return Duration.ofMillis(t.startMs - nowMs);
    }
}
`n`n========== FILE: launcher\app\src\main\java\com\gathin\tvhome\GamepadPassthrough.java ==========
package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService;
import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityServiceInfo;
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.IntentFilter;
import android.hardware.input.InputManager;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.InputDevice;

/**
 * Stops HomeKeyService and InputKeyService filtering keys while a game controller is connected. With key filtering on,
 * Android routes every key through the accessibility layer and re-injects the ones the service passes on, and games
 * (Steam Link with an Xbox controller, on a TCL G07) stop seeing the controller's buttons as the controller's. The
 * remote buttons the services handle do nothing until the controller disconnects; filtering then comes back.
 * Off by default (gamepad_passthrough).
 *
 * With volume_pauses_filter it also stops filtering for PAUSE_MS after each volume change. On a Xiaomi MOEU0 (Google TV 14) the
 * window policy changes volume once per press while any service filters keys, and a held volume key never repeats;
 * the services never see the volume keys, so consume_volume_keys cannot repeat them either. The first press steps
 * once, a press or hold within PAUSE_MS repeats as usual, and the remote buttons work again once the pause ends. Off by
 * default (volume_pauses_filter).
 *
 * Started only with key_filter on too: with it off the services never filter, and this must not turn filtering back on.
 */
final class GamepadPassthrough extends BroadcastReceiver implements InputManager.InputDeviceListener, Runnable {
    static final long PAUSE_MS = 4000;

    private final AccessibilityService service;
    private final InputManager input;
    private final Config config;
    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    private GamepadPassthrough(AccessibilityService service, Config config) {
        this.service = service;
        this.input = (InputManager) service.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_SERVICE);
        this.config = config;
    }

    /** Null unless a switch that needs it is on, and key_filter: with that off the services never filter keys. */
    static GamepadPassthrough start(AccessibilityService service, Config config) {
        if (!config.keyFilter || !(config.gamepadPassthrough || config.volumePausesFilter)) return null;
        GamepadPassthrough g = new GamepadPassthrough(service, config);
        // Only for gamepads: a device event ends a volume pause early.
        if (config.gamepadPassthrough) g.input.registerInputDeviceListener(g, null);
        if (config.volumePausesFilter) {
            // A protected system broadcast, so Android 14 needs no exported flag.
            service.registerReceiver(g, new IntentFilter("android.media.VOLUME_CHANGED_ACTION"));
        }
        g.run();
        return g;
    }

    void stop() {
        input.unregisterInputDeviceListener(this);
        if (config.volumePausesFilter) service.unregisterReceiver(this);
        handler.removeCallbacks(this);
    }

    @Override
    public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
        handler.removeCallbacks(this);
        handler.postDelayed(this, PAUSE_MS);
        set(false);
    }

    /**
     * A gamepad has all the SOURCE_GAMEPAD bits and the SOURCE_JOYSTICK ones, as dumpsys input reports them on a TCL
     * G07. Either alone is not enough: the Bluetooth voice remote reports a joystick (BT_RC833_U1: 0x01000311), and
     * the firmware's virtual-search keyboard, which isVirtual() misses, reports a gamepad (0x00000701). An Xbox
     * controller reports both (0x01000511).
     */
    static boolean isGamepad(int sources) {
        return (sources & InputDevice.SOURCE_GAMEPAD) == InputDevice.SOURCE_GAMEPAD
                && (sources & InputDevice.SOURCE_JOYSTICK) == InputDevice.SOURCE_JOYSTICK;
    }

    private boolean gamepadConnected() {
        for (int id : input.getInputDeviceIds()) {
            InputDevice device = input.getInputDevice(id);
            if (device != null && !device.isVirtual() && isGamepad(device.getSources())) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** Filtering as the gamepads want it; also a pause's end. */
    @Override
    public void run() {
        set(!(config.gamepadPassthrough && gamepadConnected()));
    }

    private void set(boolean filter) {
        AccessibilityServiceInfo info = service.getServiceInfo();
        if (info == null) return;
        boolean filtering = (info.flags & AccessibilityServiceInfo.FLAG_REQUEST_FILTER_KEY_EVENTS) != 0;
        if (filter == filtering) return;
        // Without the flag no more keys come, the UP of a button held right now included.
        if (!filter) {
            RemoteKeys.release(service);
            // consume_volume_keys: the held key's UP will not come either, so end its repeat too.
            VolumeKeys.stop();
        }
        info.flags ^= AccessibilityServiceInfo.FLAG_REQUEST_FILTER_KEY_EVENTS;
        service.setServiceInfo(info);
    }

    @Override
    public void onInputDeviceAdded(int deviceId) {
        run();
    }

    @Override
    public void onInputDeviceRemoved(int deviceId) {
        run();
    }

    @Override
    public void onInputDeviceChanged(int deviceId) {
        run();
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.LinearGradient;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.graphics.Shader;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.View;

/**
 * A translucent glass slab: soft sheen fill, bright top specular, crisp rim and a faint outer glow.
 * One instance floats over the grid and is moved with spring animations between tiles.
 */
public class GlassView extends View {

    private final Paint fill = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint specular = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint rim = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint glow = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final RectF rect = new RectF();
    private final float density;
    private float radius;
    /** Glow colour as 0xRRGGBB: white normally, a festival's accent (diya gold) while a festive skin is on. */
    private int glowRgb = 0xFFFFFF;
    /** Glow strength: the white glow stays faint, a coloured one needs more alpha to read as warm light. */
    private int glowAlpha = 0x30;
    /** glass_style rim or halo: no sheen and no fill, only the crisp rim (and, for halo, a lighter outer glow). */
    private boolean flat;
    private boolean halo;

    public GlassView(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
        super(context, attrs);
        density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        radius = 20f * density;
        rim.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        rim.setStrokeWidth(1.5f * density);
        rim.setColor(0xCCFFFFFF);
        glow.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        // Cache the slab as a texture. The spring only changes translation, so the GPU can
        // move it without replaying clipPath and the glow on every frame. That path is
        // software-rendered on the MT5895 and is what makes the highlight crawl.
        setLayerType(LAYER_TYPE_HARDWARE, null);
    }

    /** Tints the rim and the outer glow; 0 restores the plain white glass. */
    void setAccent(int argb) {
        if (argb == 0) {
            glowRgb = 0xFFFFFF;
            glowAlpha = 0x30;
            rim.setColor(0xCCFFFFFF);
        } else {
            glowRgb = argb & 0xFFFFFF;
            glowAlpha = 0x70;
            // The rim is the accent lifted towards white, so the edge still reads as glass, not paint.
            int r = (((glowRgb >> 16) & 0xFF) + 255 * 2) / 3, g = (((glowRgb >> 8) & 0xFF) + 255 * 2) / 3,
                    b = ((glowRgb & 0xFF) + 255 * 2) / 3;
            rim.setColor(0xE6000000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b);
        }
        invalidate();
    }

    /** One of Config's GLASS_* styles. */
    void setStyle(String style) {
        flat = Config.GLASS_RIM.equals(style) || Config.GLASS_HALO.equals(style);
        halo = Config.GLASS_HALO.equals(style);
        rim.setStrokeWidth((flat ? 2f : 1.5f) * density);
        invalidate();
    }

    void setRadius(float px) {
        radius = px;
        invalidate();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSizeChanged(int w, int h, int oldw, int oldh) {
        super.onSizeChanged(w, h, oldw, oldh);
        fill.setShader(new LinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h, 0x3DFFFFFF, 0x12FFFFFF, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
        specular.setShader(new LinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h * 0.45f, 0x66FFFFFF, 0x00FFFFFF, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas) {
        float inset = 6f * density;   // room for the glow
        rect.set(inset, inset, getWidth() - inset, getHeight() - inset);

        // Outer glow: thin rings across the inset, each a little fainter, so it fades out smoothly. Three wide
        // strokes left visible bands once the glow took an app's colour at a stronger alpha. The hardware layer
        // caches the result, so the rings cost one draw, not one per frame of the spring.
        if (!flat || halo) {
            int rings = 12;
            float step = inset / rings;
            int alpha = flat ? glowAlpha / 2 : glowAlpha;
            glow.setStrokeWidth(step + 0.5f);
            for (int i = 0; i < rings; i++) {
                float o = step * (i + 0.5f);
                float t = 1f - (float) i / rings;
                glow.setColor(Math.round(alpha * t) << 24 | glowRgb);
                canvas.drawRoundRect(rect.left - o, rect.top - o, rect.right + o, rect.bottom + o, radius + o, radius + o, glow);
            }
        }
        if (flat) {
            canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, radius, radius, rim);
            return;
        }

        canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, radius, radius, fill);

        // Sheen across the top 45%: clipRect stays on the GPU (clipPath did not on the MT5895) and
        // the round rect under it keeps the top corners rounded with a flat bottom edge.
        canvas.save();
        canvas.clipRect(rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.top + rect.height() * 0.45f);
        canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, radius, radius, specular);
        canvas.restore();

        canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, radius, radius, rim);
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

/** Physical left/right boundaries for a grid whose first column follows its reading direction. */
final class GridNavigation {
    private GridNavigation() { }

    static boolean atHorizontalEdge(int position, int count, int columns, boolean rtl, boolean left) {
        boolean towardStart = left != rtl;
        if (towardStart) return position % columns == 0;
        return position % columns == columns - 1 || position == count - 1;
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.BroadcastReceiver;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;

/**
 * Opt in to leaving the home helper while the screen is off.
 * {@code adb shell am broadcast -a com.gathin.tvhome.GUARD -n com.gathin.tvhome/.GuardConfig --ez guard_off_in_standby true}
 */
public class GuardConfig extends BroadcastReceiver {
    @Override
    public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
        if (intent.hasExtra("guard_off_in_standby")) {
            GuardKeep.setOffInStandby(context, intent.getBooleanExtra("guard_off_in_standby", false));
            GuardKeep.ensureHomeKey(context);
        }
        setResultData("guard_off_in_standby=" + GuardKeep.offInStandby(context));
    }

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.Manifest;
import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService;
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver;
import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.IntentFilter;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.os.PowerManager;
import android.os.UserManager;
import android.provider.Settings;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Keeps {@link HomeKeyService} on the accessibility list, the way a China-market TV needs it.
 *
 * TCL and Xiaomi start their own launcher at boot and force-stop a third-party one, which also
 * drops its accessibility service. {@link GuardRevival} is bound again by the system afterwards
 * and calls {@link #ensureHomeKey}. With {@code guard_off_in_standby} the service removes itself
 * while the screen is off: on a TCL tc8000 the power key never woke the set while an accessibility
 * service of this app stayed bound.
 */
final class GuardKeep {
    static final String ACTION = "com.gathin.tvhome.GUARD";
    private static final String PREFS = "guard";
    private static final String KEY_OFF = "off_in_standby";

    private static BroadcastReceiver screenOn;

    private GuardKeep() {
    }

    static boolean offInStandby(Context context) {
        UserManager users = context.getSystemService(UserManager.class);
        if (users != null && !users.isUserUnlocked()) return false;
        return context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE).getBoolean(KEY_OFF, false);
    }

    static void setOffInStandby(Context context, boolean off) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit().putBoolean(KEY_OFF, off).commit();
    }

    /** Puts HomeKeyService back on the enabled list when standby exit is opted in. Other services stay. */
    static void ensureHomeKey(Context context) {
        // The helper may already be bound. Arming only inside onServiceConnected misses an opt-in
        // that arrives after that, so the first screen-off does nothing (Philips 65PUS8102).
        HomeKeyService.applyStandbyOptIn();
        if (!offInStandby(context)) return;
        if (context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS)
                != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) return;
        PowerManager power = context.getSystemService(PowerManager.class);
        // Still off: binding the helper again would sit on the power key. Wait for the screen.
        if (power != null && !power.isInteractive()) {
            watchScreenOn(context.getApplicationContext());
            return;
        }
        try {
            ComponentName mine = new ComponentName(context, HomeKeyService.class);
            String list = Settings.Secure.getString(context.getContentResolver(),
                    Settings.Secure.ENABLED_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICES);
            List<String> entries = new ArrayList<>();
            boolean found = false;
            if (list != null && !list.equals("null")) {
                for (String entry : list.split(":")) {
                    if (entry.isEmpty()) continue;
                    ComponentName name = ComponentName.unflattenFromString(entry);
                    if (mine.equals(name)) found = true;
                    entries.add(entry);
                }
            }
            if (!found) {
                entries.add(mine.flattenToShortString());
                Settings.Secure.putString(context.getContentResolver(),
                        Settings.Secure.ENABLED_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICES, String.join(":", entries));
            }
            Settings.Secure.putInt(context.getContentResolver(), Settings.Secure.ACCESSIBILITY_ENABLED, 1);
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
            // The settings are the system's; a refusal leaves the helper as it was.
        }
    }

    /** Drops the service from the list and puts it back on the next SCREEN_ON. The process has to stay up. */
    static void stepOut(AccessibilityService service) {
        watchScreenOn(service.getApplicationContext());
        service.disableSelf();
    }

    private static void watchScreenOn(Context app) {
        if (screenOn != null) return;
        BroadcastReceiver receiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
            @Override
            public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
                if (screenOn != this) return;
                screenOn = null;
                try {
                    app.unregisterReceiver(this);
                } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
                }
                ensureHomeKey(app);
            }
        };
        screenOn = receiver;
        app.registerReceiver(receiver, new IntentFilter(Intent.ACTION_SCREEN_ON));
    }
}
`n`n========== FILE: launcher\app\src\main\java\com\gathin\tvhome\GuardRevival.java ==========
package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.BroadcastReceiver;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.IntentFilter;
import android.os.UserManager;
import android.service.notification.NotificationListenerService;

/**
 * Starts this launcher's process after the firmware has killed it.
 *
 * A notification listener keeps its approval across a force stop, and the system binds it again
 * once the process is gone. That rebind is what brings Home back on TCL and Xiaomi. No notification
 * is read. Enable with {@code cmd notification allow_listener com.gathin.tvhome/.GuardRevival}.
 */
public class GuardRevival extends NotificationListenerService {
    private BroadcastReceiver unlocked;

    @Override
    public void onListenerConnected() {
        UserManager users = getSystemService(UserManager.class);
        if (users != null && !users.isUserUnlocked()) {
            if (unlocked != null) return;
            unlocked = new BroadcastReceiver() {
                @Override
                public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
                    stopWaiting();
                    GuardKeep.ensureHomeKey(GuardRevival.this);
                }
            };
            registerReceiver(unlocked, new IntentFilter(Intent.ACTION_USER_UNLOCKED));
            if (users.isUserUnlocked()) {
                stopWaiting();
                GuardKeep.ensureHomeKey(this);
            }
            return;
        }
        GuardKeep.ensureHomeKey(this);
    }

    private void stopWaiting() {
        if (unlocked == null) return;
        try {
            unregisterReceiver(unlocked);
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
        }
        unlocked = null;
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        stopWaiting();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}
`n`n========== FILE: launcher\app\src\main\java\com\gathin\tvhome\HeroArt.java ==========
package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;

/**
 * The cinematic shelf's backdrop: an app's artwork reduced to 48×27 pixels, saturated and smoothed,
 * then stretched over the screen by its ImageView. Bilinear filtering of an image that small is a
 * blur that costs one tiny texture; a real blur would mean RenderScript or a shader pass per frame,
 * which a 1 GB TV cannot spare.
 */
final class HeroArt {
    static final int W = 48, H = 27;
    private static final float SATURATION = 1.7f;

    private HeroArt() {
    }

    /** The softened artwork, about 5 KB; null when there is nothing to draw. */
    static Bitmap from(Drawable live) {
        if (live == null) return null;
        // Draw a private copy: changing the bounds of the drawable a tile shows would blank the tile.
        Drawable d = live.getConstantState() != null ? live.getConstantState().newDrawable().mutate() : live;
        Rect saved = new Rect(d.getBounds());
        Bitmap big = Bitmap.createBitmap(W * 4, H * 4, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas c = new Canvas(big);
        c.drawColor(Color.BLACK);
        d.setBounds(0, 0, big.getWidth(), big.getHeight());
        d.draw(c);
        d.setBounds(saved);
        // Halve twice: each filtered halving averages 2×2 pixels, where one 4× step would skip most of them.
        Bitmap half = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(big, W * 2, H * 2, true);
        big.recycle();
        Bitmap small = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(half, W, H, true);
        half.recycle();

        int[] px = new int[W * H];
        small.getPixels(px, 0, W, 0, 0, W, H);
        saturate(px);
        // Three box passes approximate a gaussian, so the stretched image shows no seams between pixels.
        for (int pass = 0; pass < 3; pass++) {
            px = boxBlur(px, W, H, 2, true);
            px = boxBlur(px, W, H, 2, false);
        }
        Bitmap out = small.isMutable() ? small : small.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, true);
        if (out != small) small.recycle();
        out.setPixels(px, 0, W, 0, 0, W, H);
        return out;
    }

    private static void saturate(int[] px) {
        for (int i = 0; i < px.length; i++) {
            int p = px[i];
            int r = Color.red(p), g = Color.green(p), b = Color.blue(p);
            float lum = 0.2126f * r + 0.7152f * g + 0.0722f * b;
            px[i] = Color.rgb(clamp(lum + (r - lum) * SATURATION), clamp(lum + (g - lum) * SATURATION),
                    clamp(lum + (b - lum) * SATURATION));
        }
    }

    private static int clamp(float v) {
        return v < 0 ? 0 : v > 255 ? 255 : Math.round(v);
    }

    /** One box blur pass along rows (horizontal) or columns, edges clamped. */
    private static int[] boxBlur(int[] src, int w, int h, int radius, boolean horizontal) {
        int[] dst = new int[src.length];
        int lines = horizontal ? h : w, length = horizontal ? w : h, span = 2 * radius + 1;
        for (int line = 0; line < lines; line++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
                int r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
                for (int k = -radius; k <= radius; k++) {
                    int j = Math.max(0, Math.min(length - 1, i + k));
                    int p = horizontal ? src[line * w + j] : src[j * w + line];
                    r += Color.red(p);
                    g += Color.green(p);
                    b += Color.blue(p);
                }
                dst[horizontal ? line * w + i : i * w + line] = Color.rgb(r / span, g / span, b / span);
            }
        }
        return dst;
    }
}
