package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService;
import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityServiceInfo;
import android.content.ActivityNotFoundException;
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver;
import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.IntentFilter;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.PowerManager;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.os.UserManager;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.content.pm.ResolveInfo;
import android.provider.Settings;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.ViewConfiguration;
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityEvent;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Sends the remote's Home button to this launcher on remotes that emit KEYCODE_ALL_APPS for Home
 * (Xiaomi sticks and boxes). Android TV 9 routes that key only to the system-image launcher, so once
 * the stock launcher is disabled the button does nothing. Every other key passes through untouched.
 *
 * With stock_home_redirect set, it also sends the stock launcher's home screen back here, for firmware that turns
 * that launcher on again after it was disabled (XGIMI's xrmservice does, on its own remote keys), or that cannot be
 * disabled at all, and a short press of Home opens this launcher even when the stock home is already on screen.
 *
 * With power_on_home set, a Live TV window (live_tv_package) that the firmware opens by itself at power-on is sent
 * back here too, until the first key press after boot or after the screen turns on (Changhong / Homwee boards).
 * With power_on_home_always set, Home comes up at every power-on whatever is in front, for TVs that resume their
 * last source: a Philips back on an HDMI input sends no window event until the input has a picture.
 *
 * With home_long_press_home set, it takes every Home press, so one held past the long-press timeout opens this launcher
 * instead of Android's ALL_APPS action, which nothing answers once the stock launcher is disabled (Philips TPM191E).
 *
 * Enable over adb:
 *   settings put secure enabled_accessibility_services com.gathin.tvhome/.HomeKeyService
 *   settings put secure accessibility_enabled 1
 */
public class HomeKeyService extends AccessibilityService {

    /** restore_key_services was on when the config was read: this helper is noted for ServiceRepair. */
    private boolean repairRecord;
    /** Remote buttons that should open Settings (config.xml, settings_key_scancodes and settings_key_keycodes). */
    private int[] settingsScancodes = new int[0];
    private int[] settingsKeycodes = new int[0];
    private boolean settingsPanel;
    private boolean settingsClearTask;
    /** consume_volume_keys: Volume Up/Down go to VolumeKeys instead of on to the firmware. */
    private boolean consumeVolumeKeys;
    /** app_keys, the same maps InputKeyService reads, for setups that run only this service. */
    private Map<Integer, String> appKeys = Collections.emptyMap();
    private Map<Integer, String> appScancodes = Collections.emptyMap();
    private Map<Integer, String> holdAppKeys = Collections.emptyMap();
    private Map<Integer, String> holdAppScancodes = Collections.emptyMap();

    /** Waits for the user to unlock when Android binds this service at boot; null once the config is read. */
    private BroadcastReceiver unlockReceiver;
    /** The stock launcher's HOME activities (stock_home_redirect), disabled ones included. */
    private final Set<String> stockHome = new HashSet<>();
    /** stock_home_redirect, the stock launcher's package. */
    private String stockHomePackage = "";
    /** power_on_home: the Live TV package to send back to Home, empty when off; armed until this uptime or a key. */
    private String powerOnLiveTv = "";
    private long powerOnUntil;
    /** home_long_press_home: this service takes every Home press, held ones included. */
    private boolean homeLongPressHome;
    /** app_keys "front:" entries; the package in front goes to RemoteKeys.frontPackage, for both helpers. */
    private Map<Integer, String> frontAppKeys = Collections.emptyMap();
    private Map<Integer, String> frontAppScancodes = Collections.emptyMap();
    /** power_on_home_always: Home at every power-on, not only over Live TV. */
    private boolean powerOnAlways;
    /** power_on_home: re-arms after the screen turns on; null unless the key is on. */
    private BroadcastReceiver screenOnReceiver;
    /** Stops key filtering while a game controller is connected or after a volume change; null unless gamepad_passthrough or volume_pauses_filter, and key_filter, or before the unlock. */
    private GamepadPassthrough gamepads;
    /** Screen-off receiver while guard_off_in_standby is set; null otherwise. */
    private BroadcastReceiver standbyExit;
    /** disableSelf is how this service leaves for standby, not the user turning it off. */
    private boolean steppingOut;
    /** The bound helper, so the opt-in broadcast can arm it without waiting for a new connection. */
    static HomeKeyService running;

    @Override
    protected void onServiceConnected() {
        super.onServiceConnected();
        running = this;
        settingsScancodes = getResources().getIntArray(R.array.settings_key_scancodes);
        // The service is directBootAware: Android 11 skips a service that is not while the user is still
        // locked at boot, writes accessibility_enabled=0 and, on TCL G03 firmware, never binds it after the
        // unlock. Config.load reads credential-protected storage, so wait for the unlock before reading it.
        UserManager users = getSystemService(UserManager.class);
        if (users.isUserUnlocked()) {
            loadConfig();
            return;
        }
        unlockReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
            @Override
            public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
                stopWaitingForUnlock();
                loadConfig();
            }
        };
        registerReceiver(unlockReceiver, new IntentFilter(Intent.ACTION_USER_UNLOCKED));
        // The unlock may have happened between the check and the registration.
        if (users.isUserUnlocked()) {
            stopWaitingForUnlock();
            loadConfig();
        }
    }

    private void stopWaitingForUnlock() {
        if (unlockReceiver == null) return;
        unregisterReceiver(unlockReceiver);
        unlockReceiver = null;
    }

    /** The opt-in broadcast: arm this binding now, or drop the receiver if the opt-in was turned off. */
    static void applyStandbyOptIn() {
        HomeKeyService service = running;
        if (service == null) return;
        if (GuardKeep.offInStandby(service)) service.armStandbyExit();
        else service.disarmStandbyExit();
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        if (running == this) running = null;
        RemoteKeys.frontPackage = "";
        RemoteKeys.release(this);
        stopWaitingForUnlock();
        if (screenOnReceiver != null) unregisterReceiver(screenOnReceiver);
        if (standbyExit != null) {
            try {
                unregisterReceiver(standbyExit);
            } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
            }
            standbyExit = null;
        }
        if (gamepads != null) gamepads.stop();
        if (consumeVolumeKeys) VolumeKeys.stop();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    /** Some TCL boards never wake from the remote while this helper stays bound with the screen off. */
    private void armStandbyExit() {
        if (standbyExit != null || !GuardKeep.offInStandby(this)) return;
        standbyExit = new BroadcastReceiver() {
            @Override
            public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
                if (!Intent.ACTION_SCREEN_OFF.equals(intent.getAction())) return;
                leaveForStandby();
            }
        };
        registerReceiver(standbyExit, new IntentFilter(Intent.ACTION_SCREEN_OFF));
        PowerManager power = getSystemService(PowerManager.class);
        if (power != null && !power.isInteractive()) leaveForStandby();
    }

    private void disarmStandbyExit() {
        if (standbyExit == null) return;
        try {
            unregisterReceiver(standbyExit);
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
        }
        standbyExit = null;
    }

    private void leaveForStandby() {
        steppingOut = true;
        GuardKeep.stepOut(this);
    }

    private void loadConfig() {
        // Keycodes and the panel choice can also come from a theme; theme.sh restarts this service.
        Config config = Config.load(this);
        // restore_key_services: note that this helper runs, so Home can put it back after a force stop. Here, not
        // in onServiceConnected: the note is in credential-protected storage too, readable only after the unlock.
        repairRecord = config.restoreKeyServices;
        if (repairRecord) ServiceRepair.connected(this, getClass());
        settingsKeycodes = config.settingsKeycodes;
        settingsPanel = config.settingsKeyPanel;
        settingsClearTask = config.settingsKeyClearTask;
        consumeVolumeKeys = config.consumeVolumeKeys;
        appKeys = RemoteKeys.parseAppKeys(config.appKeys);
        appScancodes = RemoteKeys.parseAppScancodes(config.appKeys);
        RemoteKeys.applyKeyFilter(this, config.keyFilter);
        homeLongPressHome = config.homeLongPressHome;
        frontAppKeys = RemoteKeys.parseFrontAppKeys(config.appKeys);
        frontAppScancodes = RemoteKeys.parseFrontAppScancodes(config.appKeys);
        boolean watchFront = !frontAppKeys.isEmpty() || !frontAppScancodes.isEmpty();
        stockHome.clear();
        stockHomePackage = config.stockHomeRedirect;
        if (!config.stockHomeRedirect.isEmpty()) {
            Intent home = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_HOME).setPackage(config.stockHomeRedirect);
            for (ResolveInfo ri : getPackageManager().queryIntentActivities(home, PackageManager.MATCH_DISABLED_COMPONENTS)) {
                stockHome.add(ri.activityInfo.name);
            }
        }
        // power_on_home, off by default. Not with boot_to_live_tv, or with Live TV picked as the Open on start app:
        // those open Live TV on purpose at boot.
        String openOnStart = config.openOnStartChoice
                ? getSharedPreferences(Config.SETTINGS_NAME, MODE_PRIVATE).getString(OpenOnStart.KEY, "") : "";
        powerOnLiveTv = config.powerOnHome && !config.bootToLiveTv && !config.liveTvPackage.equals(openOnStart)
                ? config.liveTvPackage : "";
        powerOnAlways = config.powerOnHomeAlways && !config.bootToLiveTv && openOnStart.isEmpty();
        if (!powerOnLiveTv.isEmpty() || powerOnAlways) {
            armPowerOnHome();
        } else if (screenOnReceiver != null) {
            unregisterReceiver(screenOnReceiver);
            screenOnReceiver = null;
            powerOnUntil = 0;
        }
        // home_key_service.xml subscribes to no events, so the redirects ask for window changes only when one is on.
        AccessibilityServiceInfo info = getServiceInfo();
        if (info != null && (!stockHome.isEmpty() || !powerOnLiveTv.isEmpty() || watchFront)) {
            info.eventTypes |= AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED;
            setServiceInfo(info);
        }
        if (!stockHome.isEmpty() || !powerOnLiveTv.isEmpty()) probeAtBoot();
        armStandbyExit();
        holdAppKeys = RemoteKeys.parseHoldAppKeys(config.appKeys);
        holdAppScancodes = RemoteKeys.parseHoldAppScancodes(config.appKeys);
        // gamepad_passthrough and volume_pauses_filter, off by default.
        if (gamepads == null) gamepads = GamepadPassthrough.start(this, config);
    }

    /** A tap's target: the "front:" entry while the button's own app is already in front, else the usual one. */
    private String inFront(Map<Integer, String> keys, Map<Integer, String> front, int code) {
        return RemoteKeys.tap(keys.get(code), front.get(code));
    }

    private boolean isSettingsScancode(KeyEvent event) {
        for (int code : settingsScancodes) if (event.getScanCode() == code) return true;
        return false;
    }

    private boolean isSettingsKey(KeyEvent event) {
        if (event.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SETTINGS) return true;
        if (isSettingsScancode(event)) return true;
        for (int code : settingsKeycodes) if (event.getKeyCode() == code) return true;
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        // power_on_home: the first key after power-on hands the TV to the user (power and wake keys don't count).
        if (powerOnUntil != 0 && event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN
                && event.getKeyCode() != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_POWER && event.getKeyCode() != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_WAKEUP) {
            powerOnUntil = 0;
        }
        if (consumeVolumeKeys && VolumeKeys.handle(this, event)) return true;
        // A scancode entry is more specific than any keycode, so it goes first.
        if (RemoteKeys.handle(this, event, inFront(appScancodes, frontAppScancodes, event.getScanCode()),
                holdAppScancodes.get(event.getScanCode()))) return true;
        // A keycode app_keys entry with a tap target wins over the Settings keycodes (InputKeyService opens it too, and
        // RemoteKeys answers a press once), but not over a button named in settings_key_scancodes. A hold-only entry
        // leaves the tap to Settings and still runs its hold.
        boolean settingsKey = isSettingsKey(event);
        String tap = inFront(appKeys, frontAppKeys, event.getKeyCode());
        String hold = holdAppKeys.get(event.getKeyCode());
        if ((!settingsKey || (tap != null && !isSettingsScancode(event))) && RemoteKeys.handle(this, event, tap, hold)) {
            return true;
        }
        // The stock launcher handled the remote's Settings button; with it disabled the button does nothing.
        if (settingsKey) {
            RemoteKeys.handle(this, event, null, hold);
            boolean held = hold != null && event.getEventTime() - event.getDownTime() >= RemoteKeys.HOLD_MS;
            if (event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP && !event.isCanceled() && !held) {
                Intent open = settingsPanel ? new Intent(this, QuickSettingsActivity.class)
                        : SystemSettings.intent(this, Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS);
                // settings_key_clear_task: on MediaTek boards KEYCODE_SETTINGS is also a global key that opens Display &
                // Sound in the Settings task before this helper sees it; cleared, Back from Settings goes Home, not there.
                if (settingsClearTask && !settingsPanel) open.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
                try {
                    startActivity(open.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK));
                } catch (ActivityNotFoundException | SecurityException unavailable) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, R.string.not_available, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
        // home_long_press_home: Android never sees the Home key, so a held press cannot turn into ALL_APPS.
        if (homeLongPressHome && event.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_HOME) {
            if (event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP && !event.isCanceled()) openHome();
            return true;
        }
        if (event.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_HOME && !stockHome.isEmpty()) {
            redirectHomeKey(event);
            return false;
        }
        if (event.getKeyCode() != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ALL_APPS) return false;
        if (event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP && !event.isCanceled()) openHome();
        return true;
    }

    /** Unbound by Android: the user turned the helper off, so Home doesn't put it back (ServiceRepair). */
    @Override
    public boolean onUnbind(Intent intent) {
        RemoteKeys.release(this);
        if (repairRecord && !steppingOut) ServiceRepair.disconnected(this, getClass());
        return super.onUnbind(intent);
    }

    @Override
    public void onAccessibilityEvent(AccessibilityEvent event) {
        if (event.getEventType() != AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED) return;
        // app_keys "front:" entries: only activities count, so a toast or the volume bar doesn't change the app in front.
        if ((!frontAppKeys.isEmpty() || !frontAppScancodes.isEmpty())
                && event.getPackageName() != null && event.getClassName() != null) {
            try {
                ComponentName window = new ComponentName(event.getPackageName().toString(), event.getClassName().toString());
                getPackageManager().getActivityInfo(window, 0);
                RemoteKeys.frontPackage = window.getPackageName();
            } catch (PackageManager.NameNotFoundException notAnActivity) {
                // a dialog, panel or overlay: the app under it is still in front
            }
        }
        // power_on_home: the firmware opened Live TV by itself at power-on, before anyone pressed a key.
        if (powerOnRedirect(powerOnLiveTv, event.getPackageName(), SystemClock.elapsedRealtime(), powerOnUntil)) {
            openHome();
            return;
        }
        // stock_home_redirect: the firmware turned the stock launcher back on and its home screen came up.
        CharSequence cls = event.getClassName();
        if (!stockHome.isEmpty() && cls != null && stockHome.contains(cls.toString())) openHome();
    }

    /** How long power_on_home stays armed after the screen turns on without a reboot. */
    static final long SCREEN_ON_WINDOW_MS = 60 * 1000L;

    /** power_on_home: armed for the boot window (if this bind is part of the boot) and after every screen-on. */
    private void armPowerOnHome() {
        if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < BOOT_WINDOW_MS) {
            powerOnUntil = BOOT_WINDOW_MS;
            if (powerOnAlways) handler.postDelayed(this::homeAtPowerOn, POWER_ON_ALWAYS_DELAY_MS);
        }
        if (screenOnReceiver != null) return;
        screenOnReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
            @Override
            public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
                powerOnUntil = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + SCREEN_ON_WINDOW_MS;
                if (powerOnAlways) handler.postDelayed(HomeKeyService.this::homeAtPowerOn, POWER_ON_ALWAYS_DELAY_MS);
            }
        };
        registerReceiver(screenOnReceiver, new IntentFilter(Intent.ACTION_SCREEN_ON));
    }

    /** power_on_home_always: after the firmware has brought its last source back (Philips: within 0.5 s). */
    static final long POWER_ON_ALWAYS_DELAY_MS = 800L;

    /** power_on_home_always: Home, unless a key was pressed since the screen came on (the user has the TV). */
    private void homeAtPowerOn() {
        if (stillArmed(SystemClock.elapsedRealtime(), powerOnUntil)) openHome();
    }

    static boolean stillArmed(long now, long armedUntil) {
        return now < armedUntil;
    }

    /** The settings menu offers Restart only while this helper is bound: it opens the system power menu. */
    static boolean canOpenPowerMenu() {
        return running != null;
    }

    /** The system power menu (Restart, and Power off where the firmware has it); the TV asks before it acts. */
    static void openPowerMenu() {
        HomeKeyService service = running;
        if (service != null) service.performGlobalAction(GLOBAL_ACTION_POWER_DIALOG);
    }

    static boolean powerOnRedirect(String liveTv, CharSequence pkg, long now, long armedUntil) {
        return !liveTv.isEmpty() && pkg != null && liveTv.contentEquals(pkg) && now < armedUntil;
    }

    /** How long after boot the first bind still counts as "at boot" for probeAtBoot. */
    static final long BOOT_WINDOW_MS = 3 * 60 * 1000L;

    /** stock_home_redirect at boot: the stock home is often on screen before Android binds this service, so no
     *  window event for it arrives (#1116). Once per boot, open ProbeActivity: when it closes, whatever was in
     *  front comes back and sends a window event, and onAccessibilityEvent covers it only if it is the stock home.
     *  An HDMI input or an app that the TV resumed at boot is left alone. */
    private void probeAtBoot() {
        int boot = Settings.Global.getInt(getContentResolver(), Settings.Global.BOOT_COUNT, -1);
        SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("boot", MODE_PRIVATE);
        if (!firstBindAfterBoot(boot, prefs.getInt("probe_boot", -1), SystemClock.elapsedRealtime())) return;
        prefs.edit().putInt("probe_boot", boot).apply();
        try {
            startActivity(new Intent(this, ProbeActivity.class)
                    .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NO_ANIMATION));
        } catch (ActivityNotFoundException | SecurityException ignored) {
        }
    }

    static boolean firstBindAfterBoot(int boot, int lastBoot, long uptimeMs) {
        return boot >= 0 && boot != lastBoot && uptimeMs < BOOT_WINDOW_MS;
    }

    /** Lets the system see the key, so a long press still does what the firmware gives it. */
    private static final long HOME_KEY_DELAY_MS = 250;
    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    /** stock_home_redirect on the Home key: when the stock home is already on screen (it came up at boot, before
     *  Android bound this service), Home brings it up again with no window change, so the redirect above never
     *  fires and the TV stays on the stock home until another app opens (#1116). A short press opens this
     *  launcher shortly after the system has handled the key; a long press (Google TV's quick settings) is left
     *  alone. Held time, not repeats: key repeats are made after accessibility filtering, so none arrive here. */
    private void redirectHomeKey(KeyEvent event) {
        if (event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP && !event.isCanceled()
                && isShortPress(event.getDownTime(), event.getEventTime(), ViewConfiguration.getLongPressTimeout())) {
            handler.postDelayed(this::openHome, HOME_KEY_DELAY_MS);
        }
    }

    static boolean isShortPress(long downTime, long upTime, long longPressTimeout) {
        return upTime - downTime < longPressTimeout;
    }

    private void openHome() {
        Intent open = stockHomeStays() ? new Intent(this, MainActivity.class)
                : new Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).setPackage(getPackageName());
        startActivity(open.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_HOME)
                .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_RESET_TASK_IF_NEEDED));
    }

    /** stock_home_redirect while Android's Home is still the stock launcher (launcherx on Google TV outranks this
     *  one). A Home intent would then put this launcher in the home task and make it the home process, and from
     *  Android 10 the stock launcher, no longer exempt from the limits on background activity starts, can't open
     *  apps for the remote's YouTube and Netflix buttons (#1274). openHome starts it like an app instead:
     *  CATEGORY_HOME without ACTION_MAIN is not a Home intent, but still sends MainActivity back to the first tile.
     *  A MainActivity already in the home task, as the install scripts' first start leaves it, is reused as it is
     *  until that task goes (a restart or a reinstall). With this launcher or Android's chooser as Home, openHome
     *  keeps the Home intent. */
    private boolean stockHomeStays() {
        if (stockHome.isEmpty() || Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) return false;
        ResolveInfo home = getPackageManager().resolveActivity(
                new Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_HOME), PackageManager.MATCH_DEFAULT_ONLY);
        return home != null && stockHomePackage.equals(home.activityInfo.packageName);
    }

    @Override
    public void onInterrupt() {
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.media.tv.TvInputManager;

/** Which Inputs menu rows inputs_connected_only folds behind "More inputs". */
final class InputFold {
    private InputFold() {}

    /**
     * state is the row's TvInputManager input state, or -1 when it has none to show (the AV jacks, or an HDMI state
     * that cannot be trusted). An AV jack has no hotplug detection, so it always folds. An HDMI port or CEC device
     * stays only while it reports INPUT_STATE_CONNECTED: a port with nothing on it can report
     * CONNECTED_STANDBY (TCL), and so does a device asleep in standby, so both fold. A state of -1 keeps the row.
     */
    static boolean folds(boolean hdmi, int state) {
        if (!hdmi) return true;
        return state != -1 && state != TvInputManager.INPUT_STATE_CONNECTED;
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService;
import android.content.ActivityNotFoundException;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityEvent;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Maps the remote's Input button to the system input switcher, from any app. Remotes such as the Chromecast voice
 * remote send KEYCODE_TV for it, others (KTC and Kalley Realtek Google TV remotes) KEYCODE_TV_INPUT; on Google TV
 * the stock launcher handles both, so with the stock launcher disabled the button does nothing. Buttons listed in
 * input_key_keycodes (config.xml or a theme) open the input switcher the same way, and app_keys start an app (a
 * YouTube button that only the stock launcher answered). Every other key passes through untouched.
 * Opt-in: INPUT_KEY_SERVICE=1 build-and-install.sh (or -InputKeyService on Windows) enables it.
 */
public class InputKeyService extends AccessibilityService {

    private static final String ACTION_VIEW_INPUTS = "com.android.tv.action.VIEW_INPUTS";

    private int[] inputKeycodes = new int[0];
    private Map<Integer, String> appKeys = Collections.emptyMap();
    private Map<Integer, String> appScancodes = Collections.emptyMap();
    private Map<Integer, String> holdAppKeys = Collections.emptyMap();
    private Map<Integer, String> holdAppScancodes = Collections.emptyMap();
    /** app_keys "front:" entries, chosen the way HomeKeyService chooses them (RemoteKeys.tap). */
    private Map<Integer, String> frontAppKeys = Collections.emptyMap();
    private Map<Integer, String> frontAppScancodes = Collections.emptyMap();
    /** restore_key_services was on when the config was read: this helper is noted for ServiceRepair. */
    private boolean repairRecord;
    /** consume_volume_keys: Volume Up/Down go to VolumeKeys instead of on to the firmware. */
    private boolean consumeVolumeKeys;
    /** Stops key filtering while a game controller is connected or after a volume change; null unless gamepad_passthrough or volume_pauses_filter, and key_filter. */
    private GamepadPassthrough gamepads;
    /** The bound helper, for global actions Home's own key path asks for (RemoteKeys). */
    static InputKeyService running;

    @Override
    protected void onServiceConnected() {
        super.onServiceConnected();
        running = this;
        // From config.xml or a theme's config.json; theme.sh rebinds this service after a push.
        Config config = Config.load(this);
        // restore_key_services: note that this helper runs, so Home can put it back after a force stop.
        repairRecord = config.restoreKeyServices;
        if (repairRecord) ServiceRepair.connected(this, getClass());
        inputKeycodes = config.inputKeycodes;
        consumeVolumeKeys = config.consumeVolumeKeys;
        appKeys = RemoteKeys.parseAppKeys(config.appKeys);
        appScancodes = RemoteKeys.parseAppScancodes(config.appKeys);
        RemoteKeys.applyKeyFilter(this, config.keyFilter);
        holdAppKeys = RemoteKeys.parseHoldAppKeys(config.appKeys);
        holdAppScancodes = RemoteKeys.parseHoldAppScancodes(config.appKeys);
        frontAppKeys = RemoteKeys.parseFrontAppKeys(config.appKeys);
        frontAppScancodes = RemoteKeys.parseFrontAppScancodes(config.appKeys);
        // gamepad_passthrough and volume_pauses_filter, off by default.
        if (gamepads == null) gamepads = GamepadPassthrough.start(this, config);
    }

    private boolean isInputKey(int keyCode) {
        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_TV || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_TV_INPUT) return true;
        for (int code : inputKeycodes) if (keyCode == code) return true;
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        if (consumeVolumeKeys && VolumeKeys.handle(this, event)) return true;
        // A scancode entry is more specific than any keycode, so it goes first.
        if (RemoteKeys.handle(this, event, RemoteKeys.tap(appScancodes.get(event.getScanCode()),
                frontAppScancodes.get(event.getScanCode())),
                holdAppScancodes.get(event.getScanCode()))) return true;
        if (RemoteKeys.handle(this, event, RemoteKeys.tap(appKeys.get(event.getKeyCode()),
                frontAppKeys.get(event.getKeyCode())),
                holdAppKeys.get(event.getKeyCode()))) return true;
        if (!isInputKey(event.getKeyCode())) return false;
        if (event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP && !event.isCanceled()) {
            try {
                startActivity(new Intent(ACTION_VIEW_INPUTS).addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK));
            } catch (ActivityNotFoundException | SecurityException ignored) {
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    /** Unbound by Android: the user turned the helper off, so Home doesn't put it back (ServiceRepair). */
    @Override
    public boolean onUnbind(Intent intent) {
        RemoteKeys.release(this);
        if (repairRecord) ServiceRepair.disconnected(this, getClass());
        return super.onUnbind(intent);
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        if (running == this) running = null;
        RemoteKeys.release(this);
        if (gamepads != null) gamepads.stop();
        if (consumeVolumeKeys) VolumeKeys.stop();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    @Override
    public void onAccessibilityEvent(AccessibilityEvent event) {
    }

    @Override
    public void onInterrupt() {
    }
}
`n`n========== FILE: launcher\app\src\main\java\com\gathin\tvhome\InputNames.java ==========
package com.gathin.tvhome;

import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Philips (TP Vision) saves an input's name from its Sources menu as "Name&TYPE", the type picking the icon there
 * ("Xbox&GAME_CONSOLE", "Ordinateur&COMPUTER"), and an unnamed port as the text "null". Shown as is, the Inputs
 * menu read "Xbox&GAME_CONSOLE · HDMI 1" and "null · HDMI 4". This gives "🎮 Xbox" and no name; the TV's own
 * setting is left as it is.
 */
final class InputNames {
    private InputNames() {
    }

    static String tidy(CharSequence raw) {
        if (raw == null) return null;
        String s = raw.toString().trim();
        if (s.isEmpty() || s.equals("null")) return null;
        int amp = s.lastIndexOf('&');
        // Only a type in Philips' form (three or more capitals, digits or underscores) is taken off, so "Tom & Jerry" stays.
        if (amp < 0 || !s.substring(amp + 1).matches("[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,}")) return s;
        String name = s.substring(0, amp).trim();
        String emoji = emoji(s.substring(amp + 1));
        if (name.isEmpty()) return emoji;
        return emoji == null ? name : emoji + " " + name;
    }

    private static String emoji(String type) {
        String t = type.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (t.contains("GAME")) return "🎮";                                                   // 🎮
        if (t.contains("COMPUTER") || t.equals("PC")) return "💻";                             // 💻
        if (t.contains("BLU") || t.contains("DVD") || t.contains("DISC")) return "📀";         // 📀
        if (t.contains("BOX") || t.contains("STB") || t.contains("SAT") || t.contains("CABLE")) return "📡"; // 📡
        if (t.contains("AUDIO") || t.contains("SOUND") || t.contains("AMP")) return "🔊";      // 🔊
        if (t.contains("CAM")) return "📷";                                                    // 📷
        return null;
    }
}
`n`n========== FILE: launcher\app\src\main\java\com\gathin\tvhome\InputSources.java ==========
package com.gathin.tvhome;

import java.util.List;

/** Vendor source numbers for passthrough inputs, such as Xiaomi's EXTSRC_PLAY route. */
final class InputSources {
    private InputSources() {
    }

    /** Returns the mapped source, -1 for a hidden input, or null when the input is not mapped. */
    static Integer mapped(List<String> mappings, String inputId) {
        if (inputId == null || mappings == null) return null;
        String input = inputId.substring(inputId.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
        for (String mapping : mappings) {
            if (mapping == null) continue;
            int equals = mapping.indexOf('=');
            if (equals <= 0 || !mapping.substring(0, equals).trim().equals(input)) continue;
            String value = mapping.substring(equals + 1).trim();
            if (value.equals("-")) return -1;
            try {
                return Integer.parseInt(value);
            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** True when `input_action` names an activity ("package/.Activity", "package/package.Activity") rather than an
     *  intent action. Actions never contain a slash, so the two forms cannot be confused. */
    static boolean isComponent(String inputAction) {
        if (inputAction == null) return false;
        int slash = inputAction.indexOf('/');
        return slash > 0 && slash < inputAction.length() - 1 && inputAction.indexOf('/', slash + 1) < 0;
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

/**
 * A carved jack-o'-lantern for the network pill while the Halloween skin is on: its face glows while the TV is
 * online and goes dark when the connection drops. The candle's brightness follows the signal level (1 to 4) and
 * flickers a little while started; Ethernet burns steady. It is two pictures of the same pumpkin, dark and lit
 * (from Microsoft's Fluent Emoji 3D, MIT), cross-faded, so it reads like the other skin's photo-real icons rather
 * than a drawing. Frames run at about 15 fps only while the candle burns or fades; nothing is allocated per frame.
 */
public final class JackOLanternDrawable extends Drawable implements FestiveLamp {

    private static final float BOX_DP = 24f;
    private static final long FRAME_MS = 66, FADE_MS = 350;
    /** How brightly the face glows at each level; index 0 is dark. */
    private static final float[] LEVEL_GLOW = {0f, 0.55f, 0.72f, 0.88f, 1f};

    private final float density;
    private final Bitmap dark, lit;
    private final Paint paint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG | Paint.FILTER_BITMAP_FLAG);
    private final float[] noise = new float[64];
    private final long epoch = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();

    private int level = 4;
    private boolean primed, running, steady, reduced;
    private float glowFrom = 1f, glowTo = 1f;
    private long fadeStart;
    private int alpha = 255;

    private final Runnable tick = new Runnable() {
        @Override
        public void run() {
            invalidateSelf();
            if (wantsFrames()) scheduleSelf(this, SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + FRAME_MS);
        }
    };

    public JackOLanternDrawable(Resources res, float density) {
        this.density = density;
        dark = BitmapFactory.decodeResource(res, R.drawable.halloween_pumpkin_dark);
        lit = BitmapFactory.decodeResource(res, R.drawable.halloween_pumpkin_lit);
        Random rnd = new Random(0xC731L);
        for (int i = 0; i < noise.length; i++) noise[i] = rnd.nextFloat();
    }

    @Override
    public void setFlame(int newLevel) {
        int lvl = Math.max(0, Math.min(4, newLevel));
        long now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        if (!primed || reduced) {
            primed = true;
            level = lvl;
            glowFrom = glowTo = LEVEL_GLOW[lvl];
            kick();
            return;
        }
        if (lvl == level) return;
        glowFrom = glow(now);
        glowTo = LEVEL_GLOW[lvl];
        fadeStart = now;
        level = lvl;
        kick();
    }

    @Override
    public void setSteady(boolean steady) {
        if (this.steady == steady) return;
        this.steady = steady;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public void setReducedMotion(boolean reducedMotion) {
        if (reduced == reducedMotion) return;
        reduced = reducedMotion;
        if (reduced) glowFrom = glowTo;
        kick();
    }

    @Override
    public void start() {
        if (running) return;
        running = true;
        kick();
    }

    @Override
    public void stop() {
        if (!running) return;
        running = false;
        glowFrom = glowTo;
        kick();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isRunning() {
        return running;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean setVisible(boolean visible, boolean restart) {
        boolean changed = super.setVisible(visible, restart);
        if (changed) kick();
        return changed;
    }

    private boolean fading(long now) {
        return glowFrom != glowTo && now - fadeStart < FADE_MS;
    }

    private boolean wantsFrames() {
        return running && isVisible() && !reduced && (level > 0 || fading(SystemClock.uptimeMillis()));
    }

    private void kick() {
        unscheduleSelf(tick);
        if (wantsFrames()) scheduleSelf(tick, SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + FRAME_MS);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    /** The face's brightness now, easing from the last level to the new one. */
    private float glow(long now) {
        float p = Math.min(1f, Math.max(0f, (now - fadeStart) / (float) FADE_MS));
        float e = 1f - (1f - p) * (1f - p);
        return glowFrom + (glowTo - glowFrom) * e;
    }

    /** A candle's flicker: smooth noise around 1, a slow breath when steady, nothing when still. */
    private float flicker(long now) {
        if (!running || reduced || level == 0) return 1f;
        float t = (now - epoch) / 1000f;
        if (steady) return 0.97f + 0.03f * (float) Math.sin(t * 1.6f);
        float x = t * 7f;
        int i = (int) x;
        float f = x - i;
        float s = f * f * (3f - 2f * f);
        float n = noise[i & 63] + (noise[(i + 1) & 63] - noise[i & 63]) * s;
        return 0.84f + 0.16f * n;
    }

    @Override
    public void draw(@NonNull Canvas canvas) {
        long now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        paint.setAlpha(alpha);
        canvas.drawBitmap(dark, null, getBounds(), paint);
        float g = glow(now) * flicker(now);
        if (g <= 0.01f) return;
        paint.setAlpha(Math.round(alpha * Math.min(1f, g)));
        canvas.drawBitmap(lit, null, getBounds(), paint);
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicWidth() {
        return Math.round(BOX_DP * density);
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicHeight() {
        return Math.round(BOX_DP * density);
    }

    @Override
    public void setAlpha(int alpha) {
        if (this.alpha == alpha) return;
        this.alpha = alpha;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public int getAlpha() {
        return alpha;
    }

    @Override
    public void setColorFilter(@Nullable ColorFilter filter) {
        paint.setColorFilter(filter);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
    public int getOpacity() {
        return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.text.format.DateUtils;

import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * When an app was last opened from Home, for the cinematic shelf's "Last opened" line: the launcher notes the
 * time whenever it opens an app. No permission and nothing read from other apps, so an app started some other
 * way (a remote's own Netflix button) shows the last time Home opened it.
 */
final class LastOpened {
    private static final String PREFS = "last_opened";

    private LastOpened() {
    }

    /** Notes that Home just opened this app. */
    static void record(Context ctx, String pkg) {
        prefs(ctx).edit().putLong(pkg, System.currentTimeMillis()).apply();
    }

    /** Milliseconds since the epoch, or 0 when Home never opened the app. */
    static long get(Context ctx, String pkg) {
        return pkg == null ? 0L : prefs(ctx).getLong(pkg, 0L);
    }

    /**
     * "5 minutes ago" within the hour, then the day and the time: "today, 11:40 am", "yesterday, 9:40 pm",
     * "3 days ago, 9:40 pm", "Oct 12, 9:40 pm". The parts are Android's own wording in the TV's language.
     */
    static String describe(Context ctx, long when) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        // Under a minute Android says "0 minutes ago"; one minute reads better.
        when = Math.min(when, now - DateUtils.MINUTE_IN_MILLIS);
        if (now - when < DateUtils.HOUR_IN_MILLIS) {
            return DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString(when, now, DateUtils.MINUTE_IN_MILLIS).toString();
        }
        String day = DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString(when, now, DateUtils.DAY_IN_MILLIS).toString();
        // It follows "Last opened" mid-sentence: "yesterday", not "Yesterday". Month names keep their capital.
        if (Locale.getDefault().getLanguage().equals("en") && (day.startsWith("Yesterday") || day.startsWith("Today"))) {
            day = Character.toLowerCase(day.charAt(0)) + day.substring(1);
        }
        return day + ", " + DateUtils.formatDateTime(ctx, when, DateUtils.FORMAT_SHOW_TIME);
    }

    private static SharedPreferences prefs(Context ctx) {
        return ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.Uri;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.BiFunction;

/** Selects a configured, package-scoped action only when it resolves; otherwise keeps the normal launch. */
final class LaunchActions {
    /** A launch_actions value "view:<uri>" opens that URI in the package instead of sending an action. */
    static final String VIEW_PREFIX = "view:";

    private LaunchActions() {}

    static <T> T select(String pkg, Map<String, String> actions, T fallback,
                        BiFunction<String, String, T> resolver) {
        String action = actions.get(pkg);
        if (action == null) return fallback;
        T custom = resolver.apply(pkg, action);
        return custom != null ? custom : fallback;
    }

    private static final String INPUT_PREFIX = "input:";

    /** The TV input id from an "input:<id>" launch_actions value, or null when the value isn't one, including
     *  an empty id ("input:" alone), which falls back to a normal launch rather than an empty input switch. */
    static String inputId(String action) {
        if (action == null || !action.startsWith(INPUT_PREFIX)) return null;
        String id = action.substring(INPUT_PREFIX.length()).trim();
        return id.isEmpty() ? null : id;
    }

    /** The URI of a "view:<uri>" value, or null for a plain action. */
    static String viewUri(String value) {
        if (value == null || !value.startsWith(VIEW_PREFIX)) return null;
        String uri = value.substring(VIEW_PREFIX.length()).trim();
        return uri.isEmpty() ? null : uri;
    }

    /** The intent for a launch_actions value, limited to its package: ACTION_VIEW on the URI, or the action. */
    static Intent intent(String pkg, String value) {
        String uri = viewUri(value);
        Intent i = uri != null ? new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(uri)) : new Intent(value);
        return i.setPackage(pkg);
    }
}
`n`n========== FILE: launcher\app\src\main\java\com\gathin\tvhome\LauncherLocale.java ==========
package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Configuration;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * locale: the language the launcher shows itself in, instead of the TV's. A China-market Xiaomi offers Chinese and
 * English only, so a Vietnamese owner saw the launcher in Chinese although it is translated into Vietnamese.
 * Each activity wraps its base context here; an empty or malformed tag leaves the TV's language.
 */
final class LauncherLocale {
    // Subtags after the language, so "sr-Latn" and "ar-EG-u-nu-latn" (Arabic with Western digits) pass too.
    private static final Pattern TAG = Pattern.compile("[a-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,8})*");

    private LauncherLocale() {
    }

    /** The Locale for a config tag such as "vi", "pt-BR" or "ar-EG-u-nu-latn", or null for "" or anything that is not a plain tag. */
    static Locale parse(String tag) {
        if (tag == null || !TAG.matcher(tag.trim()).matches()) return null;
        return Locale.forLanguageTag(tag.trim());
    }

    /** base with the configured language, or base itself when locale is off. */
    static Context wrap(Context base) {
        Locale locale = parse(Config.load(base).locale);
        if (locale == null) return base;
        // Formatters that take no Context (the clock's date, the lunar line) follow the default locale.
        Locale.setDefault(locale);
        Configuration c = new Configuration(base.getResources().getConfiguration());
        c.setLocale(locale);
        return base.createConfigurationContext(c);
    }
}

    private void reverseRow(TextView[] views) {
        LinearLayout row = (LinearLayout) views[0].getParent();
        row.removeAllViews();
        for (int i = views.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) row.addView(views[i]);
    }

    private void showWallpaperPicker() {
        File dir = Config.dir(this);
        List<File> images = new java.util.ArrayList<>(WallpaperRotation.images(
                dir == null ? null : new File(dir, "wallpapers")));
        // A theme with a single wallpaper.jpg offers that picture too (Config maps the choice back to it).
        File single = dir == null ? null : new File(dir, Config.WALLPAPER_NAME);
        if (single != null && single.isFile()) images.add(0, single);
        String[] labels = new String[images.size() + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < images.size(); i++) labels[i] = images.get(i).getName();
        labels[images.size()] = getString(R.string.wallpaper_none);
        String current = choices.getString(Config.WALLPAPER_CHOICE_KEY, null);
        int checked = "none".equals(current) ? images.size()
                : indexOf(images, current);
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(R.string.wallpaper_label)
                .setSingleChoiceItems(labels, checked, (dialog, which) -> {
                    dialog.dismiss();

                        choices.edit().putString(Config.WALLPAPER_CHOICE_KEY, "none").apply();
                    } else {
                        choices.edit().putString(Config.WALLPAPER_CHOICE_KEY,
                                images.get(which).getName()).apply();
                    }
                    changed();
                    Toast.makeText(this, R.string.wallpaper_applied, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    refresh();
                })
                .setNeutralButton(R.string.wallpaper_theme_default, (dialog, which) -> {

                    changed();
                    refresh();
                })
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                .show();

    /** Off, then every app with a TV entry point by name. Saved at once; it is read on the next boot. */
    private void showOpenOnStartPicker() {
        PackageManager pm = getPackageManager();
        List<String[]> apps = new ArrayList<>();
        Intent tv = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_LEANBACK_LAUNCHER);
        for (ResolveInfo r : pm.queryIntentActivities(tv, 0)) {
            String pkg = r.activityInfo.packageName;
            if (pkg.equals(getPackageName())) continue;
            boolean seen = false;
            for (String[] a : apps) seen |= a[1].equals(pkg);
            if (!seen) apps.add(new String[]{r.loadLabel(pm).toString(), pkg});
        }
        Collections.sort(apps, (a, b) -> a[0].compareToIgnoreCase(b[0]));
        String[] labels = new String[apps.size() + 1];
        labels[0] = getString(R.string.off);
        String current = choices.getString(OpenOnStart.KEY, "");
        int checked = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < apps.size(); i++) {
            labels[i + 1] = apps.get(i)[0];
            if (apps.get(i)[1].equals(current)) checked = i + 1;
        }
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(R.string.open_on_start_label)
                .setSingleChoiceItems(labels, checked, (dialog, which) -> {
                    dialog.dismiss();
                    if (which == 0) choices.edit().remove(OpenOnStart.KEY).apply();
                    else {
                        OpenOnStart.skipThisBoot(this);
                        choices.edit().putString(OpenOnStart.KEY, apps.get(which - 1)[1]).apply();
                    }
                    refresh();
                })
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                .show();
    }

    /** The picked app's name, its package when it is gone, or Off. */
    private String openOnStartLabel() {
        String pkg = choices.getString(OpenOnStart.KEY, "");
        if (pkg.isEmpty()) return getString(R.string.off);
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getPackageManager();
            return pm.getApplicationLabel(pm.getApplicationInfo(pkg, 0)).toString();
        } catch (PackageManager.NameNotFoundException e) {
            return pkg;
        }
    }

    private static int indexOf(List<File> images, String name) {
        if (name == null) return -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < images.size(); i++) {
            if (images.get(i).getName().equals(name)) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    /**
     * A choice was saved. Home rebuilds when it next resumes because the change count moved, whether these
     * settings are left with Back or with the remote's Home button (which cancels the activity result).
     */
    private void changed() {
        setResult(RESULT_OK);
        choices.edit().putLong(Config.SETTINGS_REVISION_KEY,
                choices.getLong(Config.SETTINGS_REVISION_KEY, 0) + 1).apply();
    }

    private void setAdvanced(boolean enabled) {
        advancedEffects = enabled;
        choices.edit().putBoolean("advanced_effects", enabled).apply();
        changed();
        refresh();
    }

    private void refresh() {
        for (int i = 0; i < columnChoices.length; i++) {
            columnChoices[i].setSelected(columns == i + 4);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < rowChoices.length; i++) {
            rowChoices[i].setSelected(rowsBelowDock == i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < dockChoices.length; i++) {
            dockChoices[i].setSelected(dockOpacity == DOCK_OPACITIES[i]);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < clockChoices.length; i++) {
            clockChoices[i].setSelected(CLOCK_FORMATS[i].equals(clockFormat));
        }
        animationsChoice.setText(getString(R.string.animations_state,
                getString(animations ? R.string.on : R.string.off)));
        advancedChoice.setText(getString(R.string.advanced_effects_state,
                getString(advancedEffects ? R.string.on : R.string.off)));
        advancedChoice.setEnabled(animations);
        advancedChoice.setAlpha(animations ? 1f : 0.5f);
        String wallpaperCurrent = choices.getString(Config.WALLPAPER_CHOICE_KEY, null);
        wallpaperChoice.setText(getString(R.string.wallpaper_state,
                "none".equals(wallpaperCurrent) ? getString(R.string.wallpaper_none)
                        : wallpaperCurrent != null ? wallpaperCurrent
                        : getString(R.string.wallpaper_theme_default)));
        openOnStartChoice.setText(getString(R.string.open_on_start_state, openOnStartLabel()));
        followThemeChoice.setSelected(!hasOnTvChoices());
    }

    private boolean hasOnTvChoices() {
        return choices.contains("columns") || choices.contains(Config.ROWS_BELOW_DOCK_KEY)
                || choices.contains("animations") || choices.contains("advanced_effects")
                || choices.contains(Config.WALLPAPER_CHOICE_KEY) || choices.contains(Config.DOCK_OPACITY_KEY)
                || choices.contains(Config.CLOCK_FORMAT_KEY) || choices.contains(OpenOnStart.KEY);
    }

    private void open(Intent intent) {
        try {
            startActivity(intent);
        } catch (ActivityNotFoundException | SecurityException e) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.not_available, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        }
    }

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AtomicFile;
import android.util.Log;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.text.Collator;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.TreeSet;
import java.util.function.IntPredicate;

/** Home shortcut choices made from the library, separate from theme defaults and tile ordering. */
final class LibraryApps {
    static final int MAX_ADDED = 128;
    private static final long RECENT_MS = 7L * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    private static final int MAX_BYTES = MAX_ADDED * 256;

    private LibraryApps() { }

    private static AtomicFile store(Context context, boolean removed) {
        return new AtomicFile(new File(context.getFilesDir(), removed ? "library_home_removed.txt" : "library_apps.txt"));
    }

    static Set<String> load(Context context) {
        return read(store(context, false));
    }

    static Set<String> loadRemoved(Context context) { return read(store(context, true)); }

    private static Set<String> read(AtomicFile file) {
        try { return readStrict(file); }
        catch (IOException | RuntimeException e) {
            Log.w("TvHome.Library", "Could not read shortcuts", e);
            return Collections.emptySet();
        }
    }

    private static Set<String> readStrict(AtomicFile file) throws IOException {
        if (!file.getBaseFile().exists() && !new File(file.getBaseFile() + ".bak").exists())
            return Collections.emptySet();
        try (FileInputStream input = file.openRead()) {
            ByteArrayOutputStream bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            byte[] buffer = new byte[1024];
            int count;
            while ((count = input.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                if (bytes.size() + count > MAX_BYTES) throw new IOException("Shortcut file too large");
                bytes.write(buffer, 0, count);
            }
            return decode(new String(bytes.toByteArray(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        }
    }

    static boolean save(Context context, String pkg, boolean onHome) {
        Set<String> additions, removed;
        try {
            additions = readStrict(store(context, false));
            removed = readStrict(store(context, true));
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException e) {
            // Never replace unreadable owner choices with an empty list on the next edit.
            Log.w("TvHome.Library", "Keeping unreadable shortcut choices unchanged", e);
            return false;
        }
        if (onHome) {
            if (!write(store(context, false), additions, pkg, true)) return false;
            return !removed.contains(pkg) || write(store(context, true), removed, pkg, false);
        }
        // The removal takes precedence over theme defaults and any previous explicit addition.
        if (!write(store(context, true), removed, pkg, true)) return false;
        if (additions.contains(pkg)) write(store(context, false), additions, pkg, false);
        return true;
    }

    private static boolean write(AtomicFile file, Set<String> saved, String pkg, boolean added) {
        FileOutputStream output = null;
        try {
            Set<String> next = change(saved, pkg, added);
            byte[] bytes = encode(next).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            output = file.startWrite();
            output.write(bytes);
            file.finishWrite(output);
            return true;
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException e) {
            if (output != null) file.failWrite(output);
            Log.w("TvHome.Library", "Could not save shortcut choice", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    static boolean visible(boolean tvApp, boolean themeHidden, boolean explicitlyAdded) {
        return visible(tvApp, themeHidden, explicitlyAdded, false);
    }

    static boolean visible(boolean tvApp, boolean themeHidden, boolean explicitlyAdded, boolean removedFromHome) {
        return !removedFromHome && (explicitlyAdded || (tvApp && !themeHidden));
    }

    /** The pill after the last Home row: show_library_pill false hides it only while the top-bar button is a way in. */
    static boolean showPill(boolean library, boolean button, boolean pill) {
        return library && (pill || !button);
    }

    /** A package on library_excluded_apps (config.xml): never offered in the catalogue, unlike hidden_apps,
     *  which only keeps a package off Home while the catalogue still lists it. */
    static boolean excludedFromCatalog(Set<String> excludedApps, String pkg) {
        return excludedApps.contains(pkg);
    }

    /** OK on a library card opens the app (true) or changes its Home shortcut. app_library_selection's OK always
     *  changes it; otherwise an app on Home opens, and with library_ok_opens every app does. */
    static boolean okOpens(boolean selection, boolean openAll, boolean onHome) {
        return !selection && (openAll || onHome);
    }

    static boolean recent(long installedAt, long now) {
        return installedAt > 0 && installedAt <= now && now - installedAt <= RECENT_MS;
    }

    /** Missing shortcuts first; recent installs lead that group. The caller sorts ties by label. */
    static int comparePriority(boolean homeA, long installedA, boolean homeB, long installedB, long now) {
        if (homeA != homeB) return homeA ? 1 : -1;
        if (homeA) return 0;
        boolean recentA = recent(installedA, now), recentB = recent(installedB, now);
        if (recentA != recentB) return recentA ? -1 : 1;
        return recentA ? Long.compare(installedB, installedA) : 0;
    }

    /** After adding a shortcut, prefer another missing app; otherwise stay by a neighbour. */
    static int nextFocus(int current, int count, IntPredicate missing) {
        if (count <= 0) return -1;
        current = Math.max(0, Math.min(current, count - 1));
        for (int step = 1; step < count; step++) {
            int candidate = (current + step) % count;
            if (missing.test(candidate)) return candidate;
        }
        return current + 1 < count ? current + 1 : Math.max(0, current - 1);
    }

    /** Checked Home apps first, then apps hidden from Home; the caller sorts each group by label. */
    static int compareHomeGroup(boolean homeA, boolean homeB) {
        return Boolean.compare(homeB, homeA);
    }

    /** Keep the next neighbour when a shortcut moves away, or the previous one at the end. */
    static int nextAfterRemoval(int current, int count) {
        if (count <= 1) return -1;
        current = Math.max(0, Math.min(current, count - 1));
        return current + 1 < count ? current + 1 : current - 1;
    }

    static int compareCatalog(boolean homeA, String labelA, String packageA,
                              boolean homeB, String labelB, String packageB, Collator collator) {
        int group = compareHomeGroup(homeA, homeB);
        if (group != 0) return group;
        int label = collator.compare(labelA, labelB);
        return label != 0 ? label : packageA.compareTo(packageB);
    }

    static Set<String> change(Set<String> saved, String pkg, boolean added) {
        if (!validPackage(pkg)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid package");
        Set<String> next = new HashSet<>(saved);
        if (added) next.add(pkg); else next.remove(pkg);
        if (next.size() > MAX_ADDED) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Too many shortcuts");
        return next;
    }

    static String encode(Set<String> added) {
        if (added.size() > MAX_ADDED) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Too many shortcuts");
        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
        for (String pkg : new TreeSet<>(added)) {
            if (!validPackage(pkg)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid package");
            text.append(pkg).append('\n');
        }
        return text.toString();
    }

    static Set<String> decode(String text) {
        if (text.length() > MAX_BYTES) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Shortcut file too large");
        Set<String> result = new HashSet<>();
        int start = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= text.length(); i++) {
            if (i < text.length() && text.charAt(i) != '\n') continue;
            if (i == start && i == text.length()) break;
            String pkg = text.substring(start, i);
            if (!validPackage(pkg) || !result.add(pkg) || result.size() > MAX_ADDED)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid shortcut file");
            start = i + 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static boolean validPackage(String pkg) {
        if (pkg == null || pkg.isEmpty() || pkg.length() > 255) return false;
        boolean first = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < pkg.length(); i++) {
            char c = pkg.charAt(i);
            if (c == '.') {
                if (first) return false;
                first = true;
            } else {
                boolean letter = c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c == '_';
                if (!letter && (first || c < '0' || c > '9')) return false;
                first = false;
            }
        }
        return !first;
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

/**
 * Which catalogue load of the app library fills it, and when the popup appears. Opening the library starts a load
 * and so does a package change (install, update, removal) while it is open or still loading; only the latest load
 * fills the catalogue, so the reveal an opening asked for belongs to whichever load ends up the latest, not to the
 * one the opening started. Without that a package change in the middle of an opening left the popup unshown.
 */
final class LibraryLoads {
    private int latest;
    private boolean revealPending;

    /** Starts a load, from opening the library when reveal is true. Returns its number. */
    int start(boolean reveal) {
        if (reveal) revealPending = true;
        return ++latest;
    }

    /** Whether a finished load is the latest one, the only one that fills the catalogue. */
    boolean isLatest(int load) {
        return load == latest;
    }

    /** Once the latest load has filled the catalogue: whether the popup still has to appear. True once per opening. */
    boolean takeReveal() {
        boolean reveal = revealPending;
        revealPending = false;
        return reveal;
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.res.Resources;

import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Lunisolar (Vietnamese / Chinese) date, e.g. "2/9 âm lịch · Bính Ngọ" or "Lunar 2/9 · Year of the Horse", without ICU.
 * The astronomy is Hồ Ngọc Đức's public algorithm (new moons and solar terms from Jean Meeus' formulas); the only
 * difference between the Vietnamese and the Chinese calendar is the time zone it is computed for (UTC+7 or UTC+8),
 * which now and then moves a new moon, and with it the first day of a month, by one day.
 */
final class Lunar {

    private Lunar() {
    }

    /** Hours east of UTC used for the calendar: lunar_utc_offset, or 7 for Vietnamese, 9 for Korean and 8 otherwise. */
    static int offsetFor(int configured, Locale locale) {
        if (configured >= 0) return configured;
        switch (locale.getLanguage()) {
            case "vi": return 7;
            case "ko": return 9;
            default: return 8;
        }
    }

    /** Today's lunar date, formatted with the locale's strings. */
    static String today(Resources res, int utcOffset) {
        Calendar c = Calendar.getInstance();
        int[] l = fromSolar(c.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH), c.get(Calendar.MONTH) + 1, c.get(Calendar.YEAR), utcOffset);
        String month = l[3] == 1 ? res.getString(R.string.lunar_month_leap, l[1]) : String.valueOf(l[1]);
        String[] stems = res.getStringArray(R.array.lunar_stems);
        String[] branches = res.getStringArray(R.array.lunar_branches);
        String year = res.getString(R.string.lunar_year, stems[Math.floorMod(l[2] + 6, 10)], branches[Math.floorMod(l[2] + 8, 12)]);
        return res.getString(R.string.lunar_date_format, l[0], month, year);
    }

    /** Gregorian date to {day, month, year, leap (1 = leap month)} of the lunar calendar at UTC+tz. */
    static int[] fromSolar(int dd, int mm, int yy, double tz) {
        long dayNumber = jdFromDate(dd, mm, yy);
        int k = (int) Math.floor((dayNumber - 2415021.076998695) / 29.530588853) + 1;
        long monthStart = newMoonDay(k, tz);
        // The mean-month estimate can still be a new moon ahead when the real one falls just after local midnight;
        // one step back was not always enough, and the day before that new moon came out as day 0.
        while (monthStart > dayNumber) monthStart = newMoonDay(--k, tz);
        long a11 = lunarMonth11(yy, tz);
        long b11 = a11;
        int lunarYear;
        if (a11 >= monthStart) {
            lunarYear = yy;
            a11 = lunarMonth11(yy - 1, tz);
        } else {
            lunarYear = yy + 1;
            b11 = lunarMonth11(yy + 1, tz);
        }
        int lunarDay = (int) (dayNumber - monthStart + 1);
        int diff = (int) Math.floor((monthStart - a11) / 29.0);
        int leap = 0;
        int lunarMonth = diff + 11;
        if (b11 - a11 > 365) {
            int leapDiff = leapMonthOffset(a11, tz);
            if (diff >= leapDiff) {
                lunarMonth = diff + 10;
                if (diff == leapDiff) leap = 1;
            }
        }
        if (lunarMonth > 12) lunarMonth -= 12;
        if (lunarMonth >= 11 && diff < 4) lunarYear -= 1;
        return new int[]{lunarDay, lunarMonth, lunarYear, leap};
    }

    static long jdFromDate(int dd, int mm, int yy) {
        int a = (14 - mm) / 12;
        long y = yy + 4800 - a;
        int m = mm + 12 * a - 3;
        long jd = dd + (153 * m + 2) / 5 + 365 * y + y / 4 - y / 100 + y / 400 - 32045;
        if (jd < 2299161) jd = dd + (153 * m + 2) / 5 + 365 * y + y / 4 - 32083;
        return jd;
    }

    /** Day number of the k-th new moon after 1900-01-01, in local time. */
    static long newMoonDay(int k, double tz) {
        double t = k / 1236.85, t2 = t * t, t3 = t2 * t, dr = Math.PI / 180;
        double jd1 = 2415020.75933 + 29.53058868 * k + 0.0001178 * t2 - 0.000000155 * t3;
        jd1 += 0.00033 * Math.sin((166.56 + 132.87 * t - 0.009173 * t2) * dr);
        double m = 359.2242 + 29.10535608 * k - 0.0000333 * t2 - 0.00000347 * t3;
        double mpr = 306.0253 + 385.81691806 * k + 0.0107306 * t2 + 0.00001236 * t3;
        double f = 21.2964 + 390.67050646 * k - 0.0016528 * t2 - 0.00000239 * t3;
        double c1 = (0.1734 - 0.000393 * t) * Math.sin(m * dr) + 0.0021 * Math.sin(2 * dr * m);
        // Term by term as in Hồ Ngọc Đức's code, each with its own sign: folding two terms into one "c1 -= a + b"
        // flips the second one, which moved new moons by hours and put the 2023 leap month a month early.
        c1 = c1 - 0.4068 * Math.sin(mpr * dr) + 0.0161 * Math.sin(dr * 2 * mpr);
        c1 = c1 - 0.0004 * Math.sin(dr * 3 * mpr);
        c1 = c1 + 0.0104 * Math.sin(dr * 2 * f) - 0.0051 * Math.sin(dr * (m + mpr));
        c1 = c1 - 0.0074 * Math.sin(dr * (m - mpr)) + 0.0004 * Math.sin(dr * (2 * f + m));
        c1 = c1 - 0.0004 * Math.sin(dr * (2 * f - m)) - 0.0006 * Math.sin(dr * (2 * f + mpr));
        c1 += 0.0010 * Math.sin(dr * (2 * f - mpr)) + 0.0005 * Math.sin(dr * (2 * mpr + m));
        double deltaT = t < -11
                ? 0.001 + 0.000839 * t + 0.0002261 * t2 - 0.00000845 * t3 - 0.000000081 * t * t3
                : -0.000278 + 0.000265 * t + 0.000262 * t2;
        return (long) Math.floor(jd1 + c1 - deltaT + 0.5 + tz / 24);
    }

    /** Which of the 12 thirty-degree sectors the sun's longitude is in at the start of the day. */
    static int sunLongitude(long jdn, double tz) {
        double t = (jdn - 2451545.5 - tz / 24) / 36525, t2 = t * t, dr = Math.PI / 180;
        double m = 357.52910 + 35999.05030 * t - 0.0001559 * t2 - 0.00000048 * t * t2;
        double l0 = 280.46645 + 36000.76983 * t + 0.0003032 * t2;
        double dl = (1.914600 - 0.004817 * t - 0.000014 * t2) * Math.sin(dr * m);
        dl += (0.019993 - 0.000101 * t) * Math.sin(dr * 2 * m) + 0.000290 * Math.sin(dr * 3 * m);
        double l = (l0 + dl) * dr;
        l -= Math.PI * 2 * Math.floor(l / (Math.PI * 2));
        return (int) Math.floor(l / Math.PI * 6);
    }

    /** First day of the 11th lunar month (the one holding the winter solstice) of a Gregorian year. */
    static long lunarMonth11(int yy, double tz) {
        long off = jdFromDate(31, 12, yy) - 2415021;
        int k = (int) Math.floor(off / 29.530588853);
        long nm = newMoonDay(k, tz);
        if (sunLongitude(nm, tz) >= 9) nm = newMoonDay(k - 1, tz);
        return nm;
    }

    /** Index of the leap month after month 11 in a 13-month year: the first month with no solar term. */
    static int leapMonthOffset(long a11, double tz) {
        int k = (int) Math.floor((a11 - 2415021.076998695) / 29.530588853 + 0.5);
        int i = 1;
        int arc = sunLongitude(newMoonDay(k + i, tz), tz);
        int last;
        do {
            last = arc;
            i++;
            arc = sunLongitude(newMoonDay(k + i, tz), tz);
        } while (arc != last && i < 14);
        return i - 1;
    }
}

    /** Opens the boot's app once the network is validated (networkCallback posts this) or the wait is over. */
    private final Runnable openWhenOnline = new Runnable() {
        @Override
        public void run() {
            if (startPending == null) return;
            if (!OpenOnStart.opensNow(OpenOnStart.online(MainActivity.this), SystemClock.elapsedRealtime(),
                    startDeadline)) return;
            handler.removeCallbacks(this);   // the deadline's run, when the network came first
            Intent i = startPending;
            startPending = null;
            open(i);
        }
    };

        @Override
        public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {

        }

    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    /** Refreshes the network pill when the connection changes: at boot Wi-Fi often connects after Home is shown. */
    private final ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback networkCallback = new ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback() {
        @Override
        public void onAvailable(@NonNull Network network) {
            handler.post(MainActivity.this::updateWifiLabel);
        }

        @Override
        public void onLost(@NonNull Network network) {
            handler.post(MainActivity.this::updateWifiLabel);
        }

        /** wifi_status_warnings follows validation; signal-strength updates also land here, so skip those. */
        private boolean lastValidated;

        @Override
        public void onCapabilitiesChanged(@NonNull Network network, @NonNull NetworkCapabilities caps) {
            boolean validated = caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED);
            // open_on_start_network_wait: the boot's app opens on the first validated network.
            if (validated && startPending != null) handler.post(openWhenOnline);
            if (validated == lastValidated) return;
            lastValidated = validated;
            if (wifiNoInternetTint != null) handler.post(MainActivity.this::updateWifiLabel);
        }
    };
    /** Shows the Inputs pill once the TV registers an input: at boot HDMI inputs can appear after Home is shown. */
    private final TvInputManager.TvInputCallback inputCallback = new TvInputManager.TvInputCallback() {
        @Override
        public void onInputAdded(String inputId) {
            updateInputsButton();
        }

        @Override
        public void onInputRemoved(String inputId) {
            updateInputsButton();
        }
    };
    /** Listens for any VPN coming up or going down, even one this app's traffic is excluded from. */
    private final ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback vpnCallback = new ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback() {

    private final IntentFilter packageFilter = new IntentFilter();
    private final BroadcastReceiver packageReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
        @Override
        public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
            // Updates send REMOVED followed by ADDED; keep the tile until the new APK is ready.
            if (Intent.ACTION_PACKAGE_REMOVED.equals(intent.getAction())
                    && intent.getBooleanExtra(Intent.EXTRA_REPLACING, false)) return;
            // In the background this only marks the tiles stale; onResume rebuilds them once.
            if (!tileRefresh.onPackagesChanged()) return;
            reloadApps(false);
            if (appLibrary != null) appLibrary.refresh();
        }
    };
    // Right after boot the clock is often wrong until network time arrives; don't wait a minute to catch up.
    private final IntentFilter timeFilter = new IntentFilter(Intent.ACTION_TIME_CHANGED);
    private final BroadcastReceiver timeReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
        @Override
        public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
            updateClockVisibility();
            clockRefresh.start();   // the wall clock was set: line the redraw up with the new minute
        }
    };
    /** Keeps the Home clocks moving on Android before 12 when the firmware stops ACTION_TIME_TICK (see ClockRefresh). */
    private ClockRefresh clockRefresh;
    private final Runnable minuteTick = new Runnable() {
        @Override
        public void run() {
            updateGreeting();
            updatePanel();
            // The pill follows the network callbacks and each return to Home; only the festive light follows the
            // signal level, so only it needs this minute's binder calls (about 7 ms on the UI thread).
            if (festive) updateWifiLabel();
            sky.update();
            wallpaperPlayer.update();
            handler.postDelayed(this, MINUTE_MS);
        }
    };

        }
        btnWifi = findViewById(R.id.btnWifi);
        shamsiDate = findViewById(R.id.shamsiDate);
        stats = findViewById(R.id.stats);
        raceCalendar = cfg.raceCalendar;
        racePanel = findViewById(R.id.racePanel);
        raceKicker = findViewById(R.id.raceKicker);
        raceHeadline = findViewById(R.id.raceHeadline);
        raceSessions = findViewById(R.id.raceSessions);
        raceBar = findViewById(R.id.raceBar);
        racePager = findViewById(R.id.racePager);
        gameDay = GameDay.create(this, cfg.gameDay, handler, this::updatePanel);

        }
        vpnApp = cfg.vpnApp;
        vpnPill = cfg.vpnPill && !cfg.topMenu;
        btnVpn = findViewById(R.id.btnVpn);
        moduleCards = cfg.moduleCards;
        hiddenApps = new HashSet<>(cfg.hiddenApps);
        libraryExcludedApps = new HashSet<>(cfg.libraryExcludedApps);

        grid = findViewById(R.id.grid);
        rtlAppGrid = getResources().getBoolean(R.bool.rtl_app_grid);
        // Mirror only the app grid; the header and other locales keep their own layouts.
        // single_row: one span laid out sideways, so the same adapter, glass and dock band serve a scrolling row.
        grid.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(this, singleRow ? 1 : COLUMNS,
                singleRow ? RecyclerView.HORIZONTAL : RecyclerView.VERTICAL, false) {
            @Override
            protected boolean isLayoutRTL() {
                return rtlAppGrid;
            }

            /**
             * Every "bring this tile on screen" scroll lands here, both RecyclerView's own on focus and
             * onTileFocused's. The stock version treats the grid's top padding as the visible top, but that
             * padding only pushes the dock down the screen: grid rows scroll up into it. With the stock rule,
             * Up into a row above the padding dragged that row down to the padding line, cut it off at the
             * bottom of the screen and could scroll the focused tile out entirely, dropping focus into the
             * top bar. Grid tiles now scroll just enough to show the rect between the grid's top edge and its
             * bottom; dock tiles are left to onTileFocused, which parks the dock row on the padding line.
             */
            @Override
            public boolean requestChildRectangleOnScreen(@NonNull RecyclerView parent, @NonNull View child,
                                                         @NonNull Rect rect, boolean immediate,
                                                         boolean focusedChildVisible) {
                if (singleRow) {
                    // Sideways: scroll just enough to bring the tile's cell inside the padding. Cells are a
                    // column wide, so the row moves a whole tile at a time and the tiles stay on the columns.
                    // The whole cell, not the card rect passed in: the card is narrower and centred in it.
                    int left = child.getLeft();
                    int right = child.getRight();
                    int dx;
                    if (left < getPaddingLeft()) dx = left - getPaddingLeft();
                    else if (right > getWidth() - getPaddingRight()) dx = right - (getWidth() - getPaddingRight());
                    else dx = 0;
                    if (dx == 0) return false;
                    if (immediate || reducedMotion || !animations) parent.scrollBy(dx, 0);
                    else parent.smoothScrollBy(dx, 0);
                    return true;
                }
                if (dockRow && getPosition(child) < COLUMNS) return false;
                int top = child.getTop() + rect.top;
                int bottom = top + rect.height();
                // A row already fully on screen stays put, even inside the bottom padding (the last row
                // rows_below_dock leaves visible ends there; nudging it up was the bug). A row that has to scroll
                // in still stops at the padding line, clear of the screen edge, as before.
                int limitBottom = getHeight() - getPaddingBottom();
                int dy;
                if (top < 0) dy = top;
                else if (bottom <= getHeight()) dy = 0;
                else dy = Math.min(top, bottom - limitBottom);
                if (dy == 0) return false;
