     * Remove from Home takes the shortcut off (only with the app library on, where one press adds it back);
     * App info opens the TV's page for the app, which is what holding OK used to do.
     */
    // ---- hold OK ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // View's own long click misses on some remotes: an IR remote that sends its repeat frames as separate
    // presses, or a Bluetooth one whose repeats land after a tile rebind, never holds one DOWN long enough.
    // So the launcher times the hold itself: OK down on a tile, still down (or still repeating) after
    // HOLD_OK_MS opens the tile menu, and the UP that follows is eaten so it doesn't also open the app.

    private static final long HOLD_OK_MS = 550;
    private long holdOkDown = -1;
    private int holdOkPosition = -1;
    private String holdOkKey;    // the app under OK when it went down; a tile rebuild can move another app to that slot
    private boolean holdOkFired;
    private final Runnable holdOkTimer = this::fireHoldOk;

    private static boolean isOkKey(int code) {
        return code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER || code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER
                || code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER || code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_A;
    }

    /** True when the event belongs to a hold that opened the tile menu and must not reach the tile. */
    private boolean holdOk(KeyEvent event) {
        if (!tileMenuEnabled || !isOkKey(event.getKeyCode())) return false;
        if (event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
            if (event.getRepeatCount() == 0) {
                holdOkFired = false;
                handler.removeCallbacks(holdOkTimer);
                holdOkPosition = reordering || openPopup != null || cardPrompt != null ? -1 : focusedTilePosition();
                holdOkKey = holdOkPosition < 0 || holdOkPosition >= adapter.appCount() ? null : adapter.keyAt(holdOkPosition);
                if (holdOkKey == null) {
                    holdOkDown = -1;
                    return false;
                }
                holdOkDown = event.getDownTime();
                handler.postDelayed(holdOkTimer, HOLD_OK_MS);
                return false;
            }
            if (holdOkFired) return true;
            if (holdOkDown >= 0 && event.getEventTime() - holdOkDown >= HOLD_OK_MS) {
                fireHoldOk();
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        // ACTION_UP
        handler.removeCallbacks(holdOkTimer);
        holdOkDown = -1;
        holdOkKey = null;
        if (holdOkFired) {
            holdOkFired = false;
            View f = getCurrentFocus();
            if (f != null) f.setPressed(false);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Stops timing a held OK when the launcher is paused, loses its window or goes away, so the menu can't open
     * behind another screen. An interrupted press still counts as handled: its UP, if it comes back here, is eaten
     * rather than opening the tile.
     */
    private void cancelHoldOk() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(holdOkTimer);
        if (holdOkDown >= 0) holdOkFired = true;
        holdOkDown = -1;
        holdOkPosition = -1;
        holdOkKey = null;
    }

    private void fireHoldOk() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(holdOkTimer);
        if (holdOkDown < 0 || holdOkFired) return;
        holdOkFired = true;
        if (openPopup != null || reordering) return;   // View's own long click got there first
        int position = holdOkPosition;
        if (position < 0 || position >= adapter.appCount() || position != focusedTilePosition()) return;
        // Same slot is not enough: tiles may have been rebuilt during the hold, so the app must match too.
        if (!holdOkKey.equals(adapter.keyAt(position))) return;
        View card = getCurrentFocus();
        if (card != null) card.setPressed(false);
        onTileLongPress(position, card);
    }

    @Override
    public void onTileLongPress(int position, View card) {
        if (reordering || openPopup != null) return;
        String key = adapter.keyAt(position);
        String pkg = adapter.packageAt(position);
        // Empty dock slots and the Default-home tile carry the launcher's own package: no menu for them.
        if (key == null || pkg == null || pkg.equals(getPackageName())) return;
        View panel = getLayoutInflater().inflate(R.layout.popup_inputs, root, false);
        LinearLayout rows = panel.findViewById(R.id.rows);
        PopupWindow popup = glassPopup(panel, (int) (200 * density));
        if (dockRow && position < adapter.movableCount()) {
            boolean inDock = position < COLUMNS;
            addSettingsMenuRow(rows, popup, inDock ? R.string.tile_replace_in_dock : R.string.tile_add_to_dock,
                    () -> startDockEditFor(key, inDock));
        }
        if (position < adapter.movableCount()) addSettingsMenuRow(rows, popup, R.string.tile_move, () -> {
            if (!beginReorder()) return;
            int at = adapter.positionOf(key);   // beginReorder can rebuild the tiles
            if (at < 0) return;
            focusTile(at);
            pickUp(at);
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.reorder_hint, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        });
        if (appLibraryEnabled) addSettingsMenuRow(rows, popup, R.string.library_remove_shortcut, () -> {
            if (LibraryApps.save(this, pkg, false)) reloadApps(false);
            else Toast.makeText(this, R.string.library_save_failed, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        });
        // Some firmware has no App info page at all; a row that only toasts "can't open" helps nobody.
        Intent info = SystemSettings.appInfo(this, pkg);
        if (info != null) addSettingsMenuRow(rows, popup, R.string.library_app_info, () -> open(info));
        panel.measure(View.MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED, View.MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED);
        popup.setWidth(Math.max((int) (200 * density), panel.getMeasuredWidth()));
        // Dock tiles sit near the bottom of the screen: open the menu above the tile when it would not fit below.
        int[] at = new int[2];
        card.getLocationInWindow(at);
        int gap = (int) (10 * density), height = panel.getMeasuredHeight();
        if (at[1] + card.getHeight() + gap + height <= root.getHeight()) {
            dropIn(popup, panel, card, Gravity.START);
        } else {
            panel.setAlpha(0f);
            panel.setPivotY(height);
            panel.setScaleY(0.92f);
            panel.setTranslationY(8 * density);
            popup.showAtLocation(root, Gravity.NO_GRAVITY, at[0], Math.max(0, at[1] - gap - height));
            panel.animate().alpha(1f).scaleY(1f).translationY(0f).setDuration(220)
                    .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator(1.6f)).start();
        }
        rows.getChildAt(0).requestFocus();
    }

    private void addSettingsMenuRow(LinearLayout rows, PopupWindow popup, int title, Runnable action) {
        View row = getLayoutInflater().inflate(R.layout.item_input, rows, false);
        row.findViewById(R.id.icon).setVisibility(View.GONE);
        row.findViewById(R.id.dot).setVisibility(View.GONE);
        row.findViewById(R.id.status).setVisibility(View.GONE);
        ((TextView) row.findViewById(R.id.title)).setText(title);
        row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            popup.dismiss();
            action.run();
        });
        // The OK-up after opening the menu must not activate its first row.
        final boolean[] pressed = {false};
        row.setOnKeyListener((v, code, event) -> {
            if (code != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER && code != KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER) return false;
            if (event.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
                if (event.getRepeatCount() == 0) pressed[0] = true;
                return true;
            }
            boolean activate = pressed[0];
            pressed[0] = false;
            if (activate) {
                popup.dismiss();
                action.run();
            }
            return true;
        });
        rows.addView(row);
    }

    /**
     * Asks about the next card that has no decision for its current signing key. One prompt at a
     * time, only over a laid out grid with window focus (not under a popup or another app), and
     * the next one follows as soon as this one is answered. Nothing is shown until the owner says Show.
     */
    private void showCardPrompt() {
        if (!moduleCards || !tilesReady || promptsPaused || cardPrompt != null || !hasWindowFocus() || isFinishing()
                || reordering) return;
        if (cards.isEmpty() || !CardFeature.working()) return;
        CardFeature.run(() -> {
            showCardPromptNow();
            return null;
        }, null);
    }

    private void showCardPromptNow() {
        final Cards.Card card = Cards.firstPending(cards);
        if (card == null) return;

        View panel = getLayoutInflater().inflate(R.layout.dialog_card_prompt, root, false);
        boolean rtl = getResources().getBoolean(R.bool.rtl_menu_bar);
        if (rtl) panel.setLayoutDirection(View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL);
        ((TextView) panel.findViewById(R.id.title)).setText(getString(R.string.card_prompt_title, card.appLabel));
        ((TextView) panel.findViewById(R.id.body)).setText(card.state == Cards.State.RESIGNED
                ? getString(R.string.card_prompt_resigned, card.appLabel)
                : card.state == Cards.State.RELABELLED
                ? getString(R.string.card_prompt_relabelled, card.appLabel)
                : getString(R.string.card_prompt_body, card.appLabel));
        TextView names = panel.findViewById(R.id.names);
        if (Cards.fold(card.label).equals(Cards.fold(card.appLabel))) names.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        else names.setText(getString(R.string.card_prompt_names, card.label, card.appLabel));
        ((TextView) panel.findViewById(R.id.identity)).setText(
                getString(R.string.card_prompt_identity, card.pkg, Cards.shortDigest(card.digest)));
        TextView keep = panel.findViewById(R.id.btnKeep);
        TextView show = panel.findViewById(R.id.btnShow);
        if (rtl) {
            LinearLayout buttons = (LinearLayout) keep.getParent();
            buttons.removeAllViews();
            buttons.addView(show);
            buttons.addView(keep);
            keep.setNextFocusLeftId(R.id.btnShow);
            keep.setNextFocusRightId(R.id.btnKeep);
            show.setNextFocusLeftId(R.id.btnShow);
            show.setNextFocusRightId(R.id.btnKeep);
        }

        final Dialog dialog = new Dialog(this);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        dialog.setContentView(panel);
        dialog.setCanceledOnTouchOutside(false);
        Window w = dialog.getWindow();
        if (w != null) {
            w.setBackgroundDrawable(new ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT));
            w.setLayout((int) (440 * density), ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            w.setDimAmount(0.6f);
        }
        // One decision per prompt: the buttons and Back (cancel) all end here.
        final boolean[] decided = {false};
        View.OnClickListener choose = v -> {
            if (decided[0]) return;
            decided[0] = true;
            cardPrompt = null;
            dialog.dismiss();
            decideCard(card, v.getId() == R.id.btnShow);   // guards its own card calls; the tile reload stays outside
            restoreFocus();   // the tiles changed under the prompt; this also chains the next prompt
        };
        keep.setOnClickListener(choose);
        show.setOnClickListener(choose);
        dialog.setOnCancelListener(d -> choose.onClick(keep));
        dialog.setOnDismissListener(d -> {
            if (cardPrompt == dialog) cardPrompt = null;
        });
        // Left and Right move between the two buttons; Up and Down stay put; the ends don't wrap.
        View.OnKeyListener keys = (v, keyCode, event) -> {
            if (event.getAction() != KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) return false;
            if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN) return true;
            if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_LEFT)
                return v.getId() == (rtl ? R.id.btnShow : R.id.btnKeep);
            return keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT
                    && v.getId() == (rtl ? R.id.btnKeep : R.id.btnShow);
        };
        keep.setOnKeyListener(keys);
        show.setOnKeyListener(keys);
        cardPrompt = dialog;
        dialog.show();
        keep.requestFocus();
    }

    /** Writes the owner's decision and rebuilds the tiles; focus is left where it is. */
    private void decideCard(Cards.Card card, boolean show) {
        boolean saved = CardFeature.run(() -> Cards.decide(Cards.storeFile(this), card, show), false);
        if (!saved) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.card_not_saved, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            promptsPaused = true;
        }
        reloadTiles();
    }

    /** Dropdown under the Settings pill (hold OK): every discovered card, its package and key; OK toggles Shown and Hidden. */
    private void showModuleCards() {
        if (cards.isEmpty() || !CardFeature.working()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.no_module_cards, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }
        CardFeature.run(() -> {
            showModuleCardsNow();
            return null;
        }, null);
    }

    private void showModuleCardsNow() {
        View anchor = findViewById(R.id.btnSettings);
        View panel = getLayoutInflater().inflate(R.layout.popup_cards, root, false);
        if (getResources().getBoolean(R.bool.rtl_menu_bar))
            panel.setLayoutDirection(View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL);
        LinearLayout rows = panel.findViewById(R.id.rows);
        final PopupWindow popup = glassPopup(panel, (int) (400 * density));
        List<Cards.Card> listed = new ArrayList<>(cards);
        Collections.sort(listed, Cards::byLabel);
        for (Cards.Card card : listed) {
            View row = getLayoutInflater().inflate(R.layout.item_card_row, rows, false);
            row.setTag(card.pkg);
            ((TextView) row.findViewById(R.id.title)).setText(card.label);
            if (getResources().getBoolean(R.bool.rtl_menu_bar)) {
                LinearLayout heading = (LinearLayout) row.findViewById(R.id.title).getParent();
                View status = row.findViewById(R.id.state);
                heading.removeView(status);
                heading.addView(status, 0);
            }
            TextView app = row.findViewById(R.id.app);
            if (Cards.fold(card.label).equals(Cards.fold(card.appLabel))) app.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            else app.setText(getString(R.string.card_app_name, card.appLabel));
            ((TextView) row.findViewById(R.id.pkg)).setText(card.pkg);
            ((TextView) row.findViewById(R.id.digest)).setText(Cards.longDigest(card.digest));
            final String pkg = card.pkg;
            row.setOnClickListener(v -> CardFeature.run(() -> {
                // The list stays open; the decision is for the card as it is now, not as it was listed.
                Cards.Card now = cardFor(pkg);
                if (now == null) return null;
                decideCard(now, now.state != Cards.State.SHOWN);
                // Every row, not only this one: a toggle can move another card across the limit of 8.
                updateCardStates(rows);
                return null;
            }, null));
            rows.addView(row);
        }
        updateCardStates(rows);
        // Scroll inside the panel instead of running off the bottom of a 720p screen.
        panel.measure(View.MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED, View.MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED);
        int[] at = new int[2];
        anchor.getLocationInWindow(at);
        int room = root.getHeight() - (at[1] + anchor.getHeight()) - (int) (34 * density);
        popup.setHeight(Math.min(panel.getMeasuredHeight(), Math.max(room, (int) (120 * density))));
        // Hebrew places Settings on the left: align the outer panel inward, like its parent menu.
        dropIn(popup, panel, anchor, getResources().getBoolean(R.bool.rtl_menu_bar)
                ? Gravity.START : Gravity.END);
        rows.getChildAt(0).requestFocus();
    }

    private Cards.Card cardFor(String pkg) {
        for (Cards.Card c : cards) if (c.pkg.equals(pkg)) return c;
        return null;
    }

    /** Writes the state of every row in the Module cards list from the current card list. */
    private void updateCardStates(LinearLayout rows) {
        List<Cards.Card> drawn = Cards.shown(cards);
        for (int i = 0; i < rows.getChildCount(); i++) {
            View row = rows.getChildAt(i);
            Cards.Card card = row.getTag() instanceof String ? cardFor((String) row.getTag()) : null;
            ((TextView) row.findViewById(R.id.state)).setText(card != null ? stateText(card, drawn.contains(card)) : "");
        }
    }

    /** The row's state: a card the owner set to Shown but which is beyond the eight drawn says so. */
    private String stateText(Cards.Card card, boolean drawn) {
        switch (card.state) {
            case SHOWN:
                return getString(drawn ? R.string.card_state_shown : R.string.card_state_over_limit);
            case HIDDEN:
                return getString(R.string.card_state_hidden);
            case RESIGNED:
                return getString(R.string.card_state_new_key);
            case RELABELLED:
                return getString(R.string.card_state_new_label);
            default:
                return getString(R.string.card_state_new);
        }
    }
}
`n`n========== FILE: launcher\app\src\main\java\com\gathin\tvhome\MarigoldDrawable.java ==========
package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.animation.ValueAnimator;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.ColorFilter;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.PixelFormat;
import android.graphics.RadialGradient;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.Shader;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import java.util.Random;

/**
 * A marigold (genda phool) seen from the front: four rings of ruffled petals, deep saffron outside to golden
 * inside, around a dark centre. Petal shapes and colours come from a fixed seed and are built once. Light comes
 * from the top left and stays there while the flower turns, and each ring shades the base of the one behind it.
 * {@link #turn()} rotates the flower a further 60 degrees; the inner rings turn slightly more than the outer
 * ones. Drawn in a 24 x 24 unit box scaled into the bounds.
 */
public final class MarigoldDrawable extends Drawable {

    private static final float BOX = 24f, C = 12f;
    private static final int[] COUNT = {13, 11, 9, 7};
    private static final float[] RADIUS = {11.6f, 9.4f, 7.2f, 5.0f};
    /** How much faster each ring turns than the outer one, so a turn ruffles the flower a little. */
    private static final float[] SPIN = {1f, 1.04f, 1.09f, 1.15f};
    private static final float CORE_SPIN = 1.2f;
    private static final int[][] SHADES = {
            {0xFFE5600A, 0xFFF0800E}, {0xFFF0800E, 0xFFF79A16}, {0xFFF9A31B, 0xFFFFB524}, {0xFFFFB524, 0xFFFFC63E}};
    private static final float CORE_R = 2.9f;
    /** Direction the light comes from (top left), in degrees with y pointing down. */
    private static final float LIGHT_DEG = 225f;
    private static final int LIT = 0xFFFFE9A6, SHADOWED = 0xFFA43E00, EDGE = 0xFF6E2400;
    /** Shadows fall a little down and right of each ring, away from the light. */
    private static final float SHADOW_DX = 0.35f, SHADOW_DY = 0.45f;
    private static final long TURN_MS = 900;

    private final float density;
    private final Path[][] petals = new Path[COUNT.length][];
    private final float[][] angles = new float[COUNT.length][];
    private final int[][] colors = new int[COUNT.length][];
    private final int[][] edges = new int[COUNT.length][];
    private final float[] shadowR = new float[COUNT.length];
    private final Paint[] shadowPaints = new Paint[COUNT.length];
    private final Path core = new Path();
    private final float[] seeds = new float[18];

    private final Paint fill, edge, coreFill, coreEdge, seedPaint;
    private final Paint[] paints;
    private final ValueAnimator animator;

    private double rotation, from, target;
    private boolean reduced;
    private int alpha = 255;

    public MarigoldDrawable(float density) {
        this.density = density;
        Random rnd = new Random(0x6E7DAL);
        for (int i = 0; i < COUNT.length; i++) buildRing(i, rnd);
        buildCore(rnd);

        fill = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
        edge = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
        edge.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        edge.setStrokeWidth(0.3f);
        edge.setStrokeJoin(Paint.Join.ROUND);
        for (int i = 0; i < COUNT.length; i++) {
            float inner = i + 1 < COUNT.length ? RADIUS[i + 1] : CORE_R;
            float sr = inner + 0.6f * (RADIUS[i] - inner);
            float q = inner / sr;
            shadowR[i] = sr;
            Paint p = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
            p.setShader(new RadialGradient(C + SHADOW_DX, C + SHADOW_DY, sr,
                    new int[]{0x805A1E00, 0x805A1E00, 0x665A1E00, 0x005A1E00},
                    new float[]{0f, q * 0.9f, q, 1f}, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
            shadowPaints[i] = p;
        }
        coreFill = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
        coreFill.setShader(new RadialGradient(C - 0.7f, C - 0.7f, 3.6f,
                new int[]{0xFFE0821A, 0xFFB04E08, 0xFF7A3004}, new float[]{0f, 0.5f, 1f}, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
        coreEdge = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
        coreEdge.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        coreEdge.setStrokeWidth(0.3f);
        coreEdge.setStrokeJoin(Paint.Join.ROUND);
        coreEdge.setColor(0xFF5C2403);
        seedPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
        seedPaint.setColor(0xFFFFB84A);

        paints = new Paint[COUNT.length + 5];
        System.arraycopy(shadowPaints, 0, paints, 0, COUNT.length);
        paints[COUNT.length] = fill;
        paints[COUNT.length + 1] = edge;
        paints[COUNT.length + 2] = coreFill;
        paints[COUNT.length + 3] = coreEdge;
        paints[COUNT.length + 4] = seedPaint;

        animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f);
        animator.setDuration(TURN_MS);
        animator.setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.6f));
        animator.addUpdateListener(a -> {
            rotation = from + (target - from) * (float) a.getAnimatedValue();
            invalidateSelf();
        });
    }

    /** Turns the flower a further 60 degrees, easing to a stop. Repeated calls add up smoothly. */
    public void turn() {
        if (reduced) return;
        from = rotation;
        target += 60.0;
        animator.cancel();
        animator.start();
    }

    /** With reduced motion {@link #turn()} does nothing; a turn in progress jumps to its end. */
    public void setReducedMotion(boolean reducedMotion) {
        reduced = reducedMotion;
        if (reduced && animator.isRunning()) animator.end();
    }

    // ---- geometry, built once ----

    private void buildRing(int ring, Random rnd) {
        int n = COUNT[ring];
        petals[ring] = new Path[n];
        angles[ring] = new float[n];
        colors[ring] = new int[n];
        edges[ring] = new int[n];
        float offset = ring * (180f / n) + (rnd.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 8f;
        float edgeDepth = ring == 0 ? 0.55f : 0.45f;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            float deg = offset + j * 360f / n + (rnd.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 10f;
            float r = RADIUS[ring] * (0.96f + 0.04f * rnd.nextFloat());
            float hw = (float) (Math.PI / n) * (1.18f + 0.15f * rnd.nextFloat());
            int scallops = 3 + rnd.nextInt(2);
            petals[ring][j] = petal((float) Math.toRadians(deg), hw, r * 0.25f, r, scallops, rnd);
            angles[ring][j] = deg;
            int base = lerp(SHADES[ring][0], SHADES[ring][1], rnd.nextFloat());
            colors[ring][j] = base;
            edges[ring][j] = lerp(base, EDGE, edgeDepth);
        }
    }

    /** One petal: narrow at the base, fanning out to a frilled, notched edge. */
    private static Path petal(float a, float hw, float r0, float r, int scallops, Random rnd) {
        Path p = new Path();
        float a0 = a - hw, a1 = a + hw;
        p.moveTo(px(r0, a - hw * 0.35f), py(r0, a - hw * 0.35f));
        float sideA = a0 - hw * 0.08f;
        p.quadTo(px(r * 0.62f, sideA), py(r * 0.62f, sideA), px(r * 0.86f, a0), py(r * 0.86f, a0));
        int steps = scallops * 2;
        for (int k = 1; k < steps; k += 2) {
            float ta = a0 + (a1 - a0) * k / steps + (rnd.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * hw * 0.12f;
            float na = a0 + (a1 - a0) * (k + 1) / steps;
            float tr = r * (1.0f + 0.06f * rnd.nextFloat());
            float nr = k + 1 >= steps ? r * 0.86f : r * (0.83f + 0.06f * rnd.nextFloat());
            p.quadTo(px(tr, ta), py(tr, ta), px(nr, na), py(nr, na));
        }
        float sideB = a1 + hw * 0.08f;
        float endA = a + hw * 0.35f;
        p.quadTo(px(r * 0.62f, sideB), py(r * 0.62f, sideB), px(r0, endA), py(r0, endA));
        p.close();
        return p;
    }

    private void buildCore(Random rnd) {
        int bumps = 18;
        for (int k = 0; k <= bumps * 2; k++) {
            float a = (float) (Math.PI * k / bumps);
            float r = (k % 2 == 1) ? CORE_R * (1.0f + 0.06f * rnd.nextFloat()) : CORE_R * 0.84f;
            if (k == 0) core.moveTo(px(r, a), py(r, a));
            else if (k % 2 == 1) {
                float na = (float) (Math.PI * (k + 1) / bumps);
                float nr = CORE_R * 0.84f;
                core.quadTo(px(r, a), py(r, a), px(nr, na), py(nr, na));
            }
        }
        core.close();
        // tiny florets in a sunflower spiral
        double golden = Math.PI * (3 - Math.sqrt(5));
        for (int k = 0; k < seeds.length / 2; k++) {
            float r = 0.62f * (float) Math.sqrt(k + 0.5);
            float a = (float) (k * golden);
            seeds[k * 2] = px(r, a);
            seeds[k * 2 + 1] = py(r, a);
        }
    }

    // ---- drawing ----

    @Override
    public void draw(@NonNull Canvas c) {
        Rect b = getBounds();
        if (b.isEmpty()) return;
        float s = Math.min(b.width(), b.height()) / BOX;
        int save = alpha < 255 ? c.saveLayerAlpha(b.left, b.top, b.right, b.bottom, alpha) : c.save();
        c.clipRect(b);
        c.translate(b.exactCenterX() - C * s, b.exactCenterY() - C * s);
        c.scale(s, s);

        for (int i = 0; i < COUNT.length; i++) {
            float rot = (float) ((rotation * SPIN[i]) % 360.0);
            c.save();
            c.rotate(rot, C, C);
            Path[] ring = petals[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < ring.length; j++) {
                float l = (float) Math.cos(Math.toRadians(angles[i][j] + rot - LIGHT_DEG));
                int base = colors[i][j];
                fill.setColor(l >= 0f ? lerp(base, LIT, 0.3f * l) : lerp(base, SHADOWED, -0.24f * l));
                c.drawPath(ring[j], fill);
                edge.setColor(edges[i][j]);
                c.drawPath(ring[j], edge);
            }
            c.restore();
            c.drawCircle(C + SHADOW_DX, C + SHADOW_DY, shadowR[i], shadowPaints[i]);
        }

        c.save();
        c.rotate((float) ((rotation * CORE_SPIN) % 360.0), C, C);
        c.drawPath(core, coreFill);
        c.drawPath(core, coreEdge);
        for (int k = 0; k < seeds.length; k += 2) c.drawCircle(seeds[k], seeds[k + 1], 0.26f, seedPaint);
        c.restore();

        c.restoreToCount(save);
    }

    // ---- helpers ----

    private static float px(float r, float a) {
        return C + r * (float) Math.cos(a);
    }

    private static float py(float r, float a) {
        return C + r * (float) Math.sin(a);
    }

    private static int lerp(int a, int b, float t) {
        int ar = (a >> 16) & 0xFF, ag = (a >> 8) & 0xFF, ab = a & 0xFF;
        int br = (b >> 16) & 0xFF, bg = (b >> 8) & 0xFF, bb = b & 0xFF;
        return 0xFF000000
                | ((int) (ar + (br - ar) * t) << 16)
                | ((int) (ag + (bg - ag) * t) << 8)
                | (int) (ab + (bb - ab) * t);
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicWidth() {
        return Math.round(BOX * density);
    }

    @Override
    public int getIntrinsicHeight() {
        return Math.round(BOX * density);
    }

    @Override
    public void setAlpha(int alpha) {
        if (this.alpha == alpha) return;
        this.alpha = alpha;
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    public int getAlpha() {
        return alpha;
    }

    @Override
    public void setColorFilter(@Nullable ColorFilter filter) {
        for (Paint p : paints) p.setColorFilter(filter);
        invalidateSelf();
    }

    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
    public int getOpacity() {
        return PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT;
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

/** show_stats' memory figure from the lines of /proc/meminfo. */
final class MemInfo {
    private MemInfo() {}

    /**
     * RAM usage as {used, total} in MB, used = MemTotal - MemAvailable, e.g. "945 / 1536 MB". Used over free so
     * the line reads as a load against a known whole. MemAvailable only exists since Linux 3.14; on older kernels
     * (TPM171E Philips, Android TV 8, kernel 3.10) available is MemFree + Buffers + Cached, the estimate free(1)
     * used before it. Null when MemTotal or every available figure is missing.
     */
    static long[] usedOfTotalMb(Iterable<String> lines) {
        long total = -1, available = -1, free = -1, buffers = -1, cached = -1;
        for (String line : lines) {
            if (line.startsWith("MemTotal:")) total = kb(line);
            else if (line.startsWith("MemAvailable:")) available = kb(line);
            else if (line.startsWith("MemFree:")) free = kb(line);
            else if (line.startsWith("Buffers:")) buffers = kb(line);
            else if (line.startsWith("Cached:")) cached = kb(line);
        }
        if (available < 0 && free >= 0) available = free + Math.max(0, buffers) + Math.max(0, cached);
        if (available < 0 || total <= 0) return null;
        long totalMb = total / 1024;
        long availableMb = Math.min(total, available) / 1024;
        return new long[]{Math.max(0, totalMb - availableMb), totalMb};
    }

    /** The kB figure of a "Name:   1234 kB" line, or -1. */
    private static long kb(String line) {
        String[] t = line.trim().split("\\s+");
        if (t.length < 2) return -1;
        try {
            return Long.parseLong(t[1]);
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.ComponentCallbacks2;

/** Memory that affects the picture is released only when Home is not on screen. */
final class MemoryTrimPolicy {
    private MemoryTrimPolicy() {
    }

    static boolean shouldRelease(int level, boolean homeStarted) {
        if (homeStarted) return false;
        return level >= ComponentCallbacks2.TRIM_MEMORY_BACKGROUND
                || level == ComponentCallbacks2.TRIM_MEMORY_RUNNING_LOW
                || level == ComponentCallbacks2.TRIM_MEMORY_RUNNING_CRITICAL;
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import androidx.dynamicanimation.animation.SpringAnimation;
import androidx.dynamicanimation.animation.SpringForce;

/** Reduced motion (config.xml reduced_motion): the one spring and the one time limit every animation uses then. */
final class Motion {

    /** The longest any reduced-motion animation runs, in milliseconds. */
    static final int REDUCED_MS = 90;
    /** Critically damped (no bounce) and stiff enough that any move, even across the screen, settles in 5 frames. */
    static final float REDUCED_STIFFNESS = 15000f;
    /** The spring stops once it is within this many pixels of its target. */
    static final float REDUCED_MIN_CHANGE = 2f;

    private Motion() {
    }

    static void reduce(SpringAnimation spring) {
        spring.setSpring(new SpringForce().setStiffness(REDUCED_STIFFNESS).setDampingRatio(SpringForce.DAMPING_RATIO_NO_BOUNCY));
        spring.setMinimumVisibleChange(REDUCED_MIN_CHANGE);
    }
}
`n`n========== FILE: launcher\app\src\main\java\com\gathin\tvhome\OpenOnStart.java ==========
package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.net.ConnectivityManager;
import android.net.Network;
import android.net.NetworkCapabilities;
import android.provider.Settings;

/** open_on_start_choice: the app Home opens once after each boot, picked in Launcher settings. */
final class OpenOnStart {
    /** The picked package in Config.SETTINGS_NAME; absent or empty means Off. */
    static final String KEY = "open_on_start";
    /** The boot whose first Home has been handled, shared with boot_to_live_tv. */
    static final String BOOT_PREFS = "boot";
    static final String BOOT_KEY = "live_tv_boot";

    private OpenOnStart() {
    }

    /** Whether the first Home of this boot opens {@code pkg}: a known boot not handled yet, and an app that is not
     *  the launcher itself (which would only reopen Home). */
    static boolean due(int boot, int handledBoot, String pkg, String self) {
        return boot >= 0 && boot != handledBoot && pkg != null && !pkg.isEmpty() && !pkg.equals(self);
    }

    /** open_on_start_on_wake needs the Open on start row, which is where the app is picked. */
    static boolean onWake(boolean choice, boolean onWake) {
        return choice && onWake;
    }

    static int boot(Context ctx) {
        return Settings.Global.getInt(ctx.getContentResolver(), Settings.Global.BOOT_COUNT, -1);
    }

    /** A pick takes effect from the next boot: the Home that follows the pick stays Home. */
    static void skipThisBoot(Context ctx) {
        ctx.getSharedPreferences(BOOT_PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit().putInt(BOOT_KEY, boot(ctx)).commit();
    }

    /** open_on_start_network_wait: the app opens once the network is validated, or when the wait is over. */
    static boolean opensNow(boolean online, long now, long deadline) {
        return online || now >= deadline;
    }

    /** Android has reached the internet through the active network (ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE). */
    static boolean online(Context ctx) {
        // The application's: one made from an activity would keep that activity (see MainActivity.onCreate).
        ConnectivityManager cm = ctx.getApplicationContext().getSystemService(ConnectivityManager.class);
        Network n = cm != null ? cm.getActiveNetwork() : null;
        NetworkCapabilities caps = n != null ? cm.getNetworkCapabilities(n) : null;
        return caps != null && caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED);
    }

    /** The app's TV entry point, or its phone one; null when it is uninstalled or disabled, so Home stays. */
    static Intent intent(PackageManager pm, String pkg) {
        Intent i = pm.getLeanbackLaunchIntentForPackage(pkg);
        return i != null ? i : pm.getLaunchIntentForPackage(pkg);
    }
}

package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AtomicFile;
import android.util.Log;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * The owner's own tile order, set with the reorder button and kept in the launcher's private files (order.txt).
 *
 * Saved tiles come first in this order; apps not in it (new installs) follow by the usual rule (dock_apps, cards,
 * alphabetical) and uninstalled ones simply drop out. The file also records the dock_apps it was made under: when
 * dock_apps changes (a rebuild or a pushed theme), the saved order is ignored, so the new dock takes effect until
 * the owner reorders again.
 *
 * Format, UTF-8 text: {@code tvhome-order 1}, then {@code dock <comma-separated dock_apps>}, then optionally
 * {@code docked <n>}, then one tile key (component, flattened short) per line. {@code docked} says how many of the
 * first keys are in the dock, for fill_dock false, where an app the owner moved into the dock is not in dock_apps
 * (#499). Files without it (older launchers) leave the dock to dock_apps; an older launcher reads the line as a key
 * that matches no tile.
 */
final class Order {

    private static final String TAG = "TvHome.Order";
    static final String FILE_NAME = "order.txt";
    private static final String MAGIC = "tvhome-order 1";
    private static final String DOCK = "dock ";
    private static final String DOCKED = "docked ";

    /** dock_apps the order was saved under, comma-joined (package names cannot contain commas). */
    final String dock;
    final List<String> keys;
    /** How many of the first keys are in the dock, or -1 when not recorded (dock_apps decides). */
    final int docked;

    Order(String dock, List<String> keys) {
        this(dock, keys, -1);
    }

    Order(String dock, List<String> keys, int docked) {
        this.dock = dock;
        this.keys = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(keys));
        this.docked = docked;
    }

    static String dockKey(List<String> dockApps) {
        return String.join(",", dockApps);
    }

    static String encode(Order order) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(MAGIC).append('\n').append(DOCK).append(order.dock).append('\n');
        if (order.docked >= 0) sb.append(DOCKED).append(order.docked).append('\n');
        for (String k : order.keys) sb.append(k).append('\n');
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /** The order in this text, or null when it is not one (wrong header, a blank or duplicate key). */
    static Order decode(String text) {
        if (text == null) return null;
        String[] lines = text.split("\n", -1);
        if (lines.length < 2 || !lines[0].equals(MAGIC) || !lines[1].startsWith(DOCK)) return null;
        int docked = -1, first = 2;
        if (lines.length > 2 && lines[2].startsWith(DOCKED)) {
            try {
                docked = Integer.parseInt(lines[2].substring(DOCKED.length()));
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                return null;
            }
            if (docked < 0) return null;
            first = 3;
        }
        List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = first; i < lines.length; i++) {
            String k = lines[i];
            if (k.isEmpty()) {
                if (i == lines.length - 1) break;   // the trailing newline
                return null;
            }
            if (keys.contains(k)) return null;
            keys.add(k);
        }
        if (docked > keys.size()) return null;
        return new Order(lines[1].substring(DOCK.length()), keys, docked);
    }

    /**
     * Rank of each saved key (0 = first) when the order still applies to these dock_apps, else an empty map.
     * Tiles without a rank sort after every ranked one.
     */
    static Map<String, Integer> ranks(Order order, List<String> dockApps) {
        Map<String, Integer> r = new HashMap<>();
        if (order == null || !order.dock.equals(dockKey(dockApps))) return r;
        for (int i = 0; i < order.keys.size(); i++) r.put(order.keys.get(i), i);
        return r;
    }

    /** The saved dock size when the order still applies to these dock_apps and recorded one, else -1. */
    static int docked(Order order, List<String> dockApps) {
        return order == null || !order.dock.equals(dockKey(dockApps)) ? -1 : order.docked;
    }

    /** Sort step for two tiles: saved ones first in saved order, then 0 to fall through to the usual rule. */
    static int compare(Map<String, Integer> ranks, String keyA, String keyB) {
        Integer a = ranks.get(keyA), b = ranks.get(keyB);
        if (a == null && b == null) return 0;
        if (a == null) return 1;
        if (b == null) return -1;
        return Integer.compare(a, b);
    }

    // ---- file ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    static File file(Context ctx) {
        return new File(ctx.getFilesDir(), FILE_NAME);
    }

    /** The saved order, or null when there is none or it does not decode (then it is ignored, not deleted). */
    static Order load(File file) {
        if (!file.exists()) return null;
        try {
            Order o = decode(new String(new AtomicFile(file).readFully(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (o == null) Log.w(TAG, file.getName() + " is not valid; ignored");
            return o;
        } catch (IOException e) {
            Log.w(TAG, "cannot read " + file.getName() + ": " + e);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** Writes the order atomically. False (and a log line) when the write failed. */
    static boolean save(File file, Order order) {
        AtomicFile af = new AtomicFile(file);
        FileOutputStream out = null;
        try {
            out = af.startWrite();
            out.write(encode(order).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            af.finishWrite(out);
            return true;
        } catch (IOException e) {
            Log.w(TAG, "cannot write " + file.getName() + ": " + e);
            if (out != null) af.failWrite(out);
            return false;
        }
    }
}
`n`n========== FILE: launcher\app\src\main\java\com\gathin\tvhome\PetalShowerView.java ==========
package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.View;

import java.util.Random;

/**
 * A transparent full-screen overlay that plays a one-off shower of marigold petals. Each petal drops in from
 * just above the top edge, gathers speed as it falls, sways from side to side, spins, flips over (showing its
 * darker back) and fades out over the last quarter of its fall. Everything finishes within the given duration,
 * then the callback runs on the main thread. The view takes no focus, clicks or accessibility, uses a hardware
 * layer only while playing, and allocates nothing per frame.
 */
public final class PetalShowerView extends View {

    private static final int[] COLORS = {0xFFFF8C1A, 0xFFFFB627, 0xFFF26A0D, 0xFFFFC93C, 0xFFE85D04};
    private static final int EDGE = 0xFF7A2800;
    private static final double TAU = 2 * Math.PI;

    private final float density;
    private final Random rnd = new Random();
    private final Path[] shapes = new Path[3];
    private final Path[] veins = new Path[3];
    private final Paint fill = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint edge = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint vein = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);

    // per-petal state, grown only when a bigger shower is asked for
    private int count;
    private float[] xFrac = new float[0], delay = new float[0], life = new float[0], drop = new float[0],
            size = new float[0], swayAmp = new float[0], swayFreq = new float[0], swayPhase = new float[0],
            rot0 = new float[0], spin = new float[0], flipFreq = new float[0], flipPhase = new float[0];
    private int[] color = new int[0], shape = new int[0];

    private boolean playing;
    private long start, duration;
    private Runnable onDone;
    private final Runnable finish = this::finish;

    public PetalShowerView(Context context) {
        this(context, null);
    }

    public PetalShowerView(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
        this(context, attrs, 0);
    }

    public PetalShowerView(Context context, AttributeSet attrs, int defStyleAttr) {
        super(context, attrs, defStyleAttr);
        density = context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        setFocusable(false);
        setClickable(false);
        setImportantForAccessibility(IMPORTANT_FOR_ACCESSIBILITY_NO);
        setWillNotDraw(false);

        Random seeded = new Random(0x9E7A1L);
        for (int i = 0; i < shapes.length; i++) {
            shapes[i] = petalShape(seeded);
            veins[i] = veinPath(seeded);
        }
        edge.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        edge.setStrokeWidth(0.045f);
        edge.setStrokeJoin(Paint.Join.ROUND);
        vein.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        vein.setStrokeWidth(0.035f);
        vein.setStrokeCap(Paint.Cap.ROUND);
        vein.setColor(EDGE);
    }

    /**
     * Plays a shower of {@code petals} petals lasting {@code durationMs}, then runs {@code done} on the main
     * thread. Playing again before the last shower ends finishes that one first (its callback runs).
     */
    public void play(int petals, long durationMs, Runnable done) {
        if (playing) {
            removeCallbacks(finish);
            finish();
        }
        int n = Math.max(0, petals);
        ensureCapacity(n);
        count = n;
        duration = Math.max(1, durationMs);
        onDone = done;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            xFrac[i] = (i + rnd.nextFloat()) / n;          // spread evenly across the width
            delay[i] = rnd.nextFloat() * 0.32f;             // fractions of the duration
            life[i] = 0.6f + rnd.nextFloat() * (1f - delay[i] - 0.6f);
            drop[i] = 0.8f + rnd.nextFloat() * 0.35f;       // fraction of the height fallen over its life
            size[i] = 9f + rnd.nextFloat() * 7f;            // dp
            swayAmp[i] = 10f + rnd.nextFloat() * 24f;       // dp
            swayFreq[i] = 0.5f + rnd.nextFloat() * 0.6f;    // Hz
            swayPhase[i] = rnd.nextFloat() * (float) TAU;
            rot0[i] = rnd.nextFloat() * 360f;
            spin[i] = (40f + rnd.nextFloat() * 120f) * (rnd.nextBoolean() ? 1f : -1f); // degrees per second
            flipFreq[i] = 0.4f + rnd.nextFloat();           // Hz
            flipPhase[i] = rnd.nextFloat() * (float) TAU;
            color[i] = rnd.nextInt(COLORS.length);
            shape[i] = rnd.nextInt(shapes.length);
        }
        playing = true;
        start = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        postDelayed(finish, duration);
        postInvalidateOnAnimation();
    }

    private void finish() {
        if (!playing) return;
        playing = false;
        invalidate();
        Runnable done = onDone;
        onDone = null;
        if (done != null) done.run();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
        if (playing) {
            removeCallbacks(finish);
            finish();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas c) {
        if (!playing) return;
        long now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        float elapsed = (now - start) / (float) duration;
        float secs = (now - start) / 1000f;
        float w = getWidth(), h = getHeight();
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            float p = (elapsed - delay[i]) / life[i];
            if (p <= 0f || p >= 1f) continue;
            float len = size[i] * density;
            float fall = (p + p * p) * 0.5f;               // gathers speed, like a petal against the air
            float y = -len * 1.5f + (h * drop[i] + len * 1.5f) * fall;
            double sway = TAU * swayFreq[i] * secs + swayPhase[i];
            float x = xFrac[i] * w + swayAmp[i] * density * (float) Math.sin(sway);
            float angle = rot0[i] + spin[i] * secs + 22f * (float) Math.cos(sway); // tilts into the sway
            float flip = (float) Math.cos(TAU * flipFreq[i] * secs + flipPhase[i]);
            float sx = Math.abs(flip) < 0.08f ? (flip < 0f ? -0.08f : 0.08f) : flip;
            int a = p > 0.75f ? (int) (255 * (1f - (p - 0.75f) / 0.25f)) : 255;

            // turned edge-on it looks darker; the back is darker still
            float shade = (flip < 0f ? 0.78f : 1f) * (0.8f + 0.2f * Math.abs(flip));
            int base = COLORS[color[i]];
            fill.setColor(scale(base, shade));
            fill.setAlpha(a);
            edge.setColor(scale(base, 0.55f));
            edge.setAlpha(a * 3 / 4);
            vein.setAlpha(a / 4);

            c.save();
            c.translate(x, y);
            c.rotate(angle);
            c.scale(len * sx, len);
            c.drawPath(shapes[shape[i]], fill);
            c.drawPath(shapes[shape[i]], edge);
            c.drawPath(veins[shape[i]], vein);
            c.restore();
        }
        postInvalidateOnAnimation();
    }

    private void ensureCapacity(int n) {
        if (xFrac.length >= n) return;
        xFrac = new float[n];
        delay = new float[n];
        life = new float[n];
        drop = new float[n];
        size = new float[n];
        swayAmp = new float[n];
        swayFreq = new float[n];
        swayPhase = new float[n];
        rot0 = new float[n];
        spin = new float[n];
        flipFreq = new float[n];
        flipPhase = new float[n];
        color = new int[n];
        shape = new int[n];
    }

    /** One marigold petal, 1 unit tall around the origin: a narrow base fanning out to a frilled top. */
    private static Path petalShape(Random r) {
        Path p = new Path();
        float wTop = 0.36f + 0.08f * r.nextFloat();
        p.moveTo(0f, 0.5f);
        p.cubicTo(-0.16f, 0.36f, -wTop - 0.04f, 0.02f, -wTop, -0.3f);
        int scallops = 4 + r.nextInt(2);
        for (int k = 0; k < scallops; k++) {
            float tx = -wTop + 2 * wTop * (k + 0.5f) / scallops;
            float nx = -wTop + 2 * wTop * (k + 1f) / scallops;
            float tipY = -0.5f + 0.2f * sq(tx / wTop) - 0.06f - 0.05f * r.nextFloat();
            float notchY = k == scallops - 1 ? -0.3f : -0.5f + 0.2f * sq(nx / wTop) + 0.05f + 0.03f * r.nextFloat();
            p.quadTo(tx, tipY, nx, notchY);
        }
        p.cubicTo(wTop + 0.04f, 0.02f, 0.16f, 0.36f, 0f, 0.5f);
        p.close();
        return p;
    }

    private static Path veinPath(Random r) {
        Path p = new Path();
        float bend = (r.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.06f;
        p.moveTo(0f, 0.42f);
        p.quadTo(bend, 0f, 0f, -0.36f);
        p.moveTo(0f, 0.3f);
        p.quadTo(-0.12f, -0.05f, -0.2f, -0.3f);
        p.moveTo(0f, 0.3f);
        p.quadTo(0.12f, -0.05f, 0.2f, -0.3f);
        return p;
    }

    private static float sq(float v) {
        return v * v;
    }

    private static int scale(int c, float f) {
        int r = Math.min(255, (int) (((c >> 16) & 0xFF) * f));
        int g = Math.min(255, (int) (((c >> 8) & 0xFF) * f));
        int b = Math.min(255, (int) ((c & 0xFF) * f));
        return 0xFF000000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
    }
}

import android.app.Activity;

/**
 * An invisible activity that closes right away. HomeKeyService opens it once at boot (stock_home_redirect):

import android.app.Activity;

/**
 * The panel the remote's Settings button opens when {@code settings_key_panel} is on (HomeKeyService):
 * a few glass rows under the Settings pill, over Home or whatever app is playing. Translucent and in a
 * task of its own, so the app behind keeps running and Back returns to it. Pressing Settings again
 * closes the panel.
 */
public final class QuickSettingsActivity extends Activity {
    @Override
    protected void attachBaseContext(android.content.Context base) {
        super.attachBaseContext(LauncherLocale.wrap(base));   // locale
    }


    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle state) {
        super.onCreate(state);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_quick_settings);
        if (getResources().getBoolean(R.bool.rtl_menu_bar)) {
            View panel = findViewById(R.id.panel);
            android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams position =
                    (android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams) panel.getLayoutParams();
            position.gravity = android.view.Gravity.TOP | android.view.Gravity.LEFT;
            int inset = position.getMarginEnd();
            position.setMarginEnd(0);
            position.setMargins(inset, position.topMargin, 0, position.bottomMargin);
            panel.setLayoutParams(position);
        }
        findViewById(R.id.scrim).setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        LinearLayout rows = findViewById(R.id.rows);
        addRow(rows, R.drawable.ic_settings, R.string.tv_settings, 0, SystemSettings.intent(this, Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS));
        addRow(rows, R.drawable.ic_picture, R.string.quick_picture, 0, SystemSettings.displayIntent(this));
        addRow(rows, R.drawable.ic_wifi, R.string.quick_network, 0, SystemSettings.intent(this, Settings.ACTION_WIFI_SETTINGS));
        addRow(rows, R.drawable.ic_apps, R.string.quick_apps, R.string.quick_apps_hint,
                SystemSettings.intent(this, Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_APPLICATIONS_SETTINGS));
        // Through Home, so it rebuilds with the new choices when Launcher settings closes.
        addRow(rows, R.drawable.ic_home_settings, R.string.launcher_settings, 0,
                new Intent(this, MainActivity.class).setAction(MainActivity.ACTION_LAUNCHER_SETTINGS));
        rows.getChildAt(0).requestFocus();
    }

    /** Settings pressed again while the panel is up. */
    @Override
    protected void onNewIntent(Intent intent) {
        super.onNewIntent(intent);
        finish();
    }

    /** Anything else taking the screen (Home, an app, a screensaver) closes the panel. */
    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
    protected void onPause() {
        super.onPause();
        finish();
        overridePendingTransition(0, 0);
    }

    private void addRow(LinearLayout rows, int icon, int title, int status, Intent target) {
        View row = getLayoutInflater().inflate(R.layout.item_input, rows, false);
        ((ImageView) row.findViewById(R.id.icon)).setImageResource(icon);
        ((TextView) row.findViewById(R.id.title)).setText(title);
        row.findViewById(R.id.dot).setVisibility(View.GONE);
        TextView hint = row.findViewById(R.id.status);
        if (status != 0) hint.setText(status);
        else hint.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            try {
                startActivity(target.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK));
            } catch (ActivityNotFoundException | SecurityException e) {
                Toast.makeText(this, R.string.not_available, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            }
            finish();
        });
        rows.addView(row);
    }
}
`n`n========== FILE: launcher\app\src\main\java\com\gathin\tvhome\RaceWeekend.java ==========
package com.gathin.tvhome;

import android.content.res.Resources;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Race-weekend mode. A theme's config.json can carry an F1 calendar ({@code race_calendar}, written by
 * tools/race_calendar.py); from shortly before a weekend's first session until the race is over, Home shows
 * a small panel with the next session and a countdown. Scheduling uses the clock against owner-pushed
 * data and is tested on the JVM; display labels use Android resources.
 */
final class RaceWeekend {

    /** The panel shows from this long before a weekend's first session... */
    static final Duration LEAD = Duration.ofHours(12);
    /** ...until this long after the race starts: a race runs about two hours, then the result settles. */
    static final Duration TAIL = Duration.ofHours(4);

    enum Status { DONE, LIVE, NEXT, LATER }

    static final class Session {
        /** As written in the calendar: FP1, FP2, FP3, SPRINT QUALI, SPRINT, QUALIFYING or RACE. */
        final String name;
        final Instant start;

        Session(String name, Instant start) {
            this.name = name.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
            this.start = start;
        }

        boolean isRace() {
            return name.equals("RACE");
        }

        /** Roughly how long the session is live; only used to tell live from done. */
        Duration length() {
            if (isRace()) return Duration.ofHours(2);
            if (name.equals("SPRINT QUALI")) return Duration.ofMinutes(45);
            return Duration.ofHours(1);
        }

        /** The name in the countdown line: "Qualifying in 2h 14m". */
        String title(Resources res) {
            switch (name) {
                case "FP1": return res.getString(R.string.race_practice_1);
                case "FP2": return res.getString(R.string.race_practice_2);
                case "FP3": return res.getString(R.string.race_practice_3);
                case "SPRINT QUALI": return res.getString(R.string.race_sprint_qualifying);
                case "SPRINT": return res.getString(R.string.race_sprint);
                case "QUALIFYING": return res.getString(R.string.race_qualifying);
                case "RACE": return res.getString(R.string.race_race);
                default: return name.charAt(0) + name.substring(1).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            }
        }

        /** The name in the session row, kept short so a whole weekend fits on one line. */
        String shortName(Resources res) {
            switch (name) {
                case "FP1": return res.getString(R.string.race_practice_1_short);
                case "FP2": return res.getString(R.string.race_practice_2_short);
                case "FP3": return res.getString(R.string.race_practice_3_short);
                case "SPRINT QUALI": return res.getString(R.string.race_sprint_qualifying_short);
                case "SPRINT": return res.getString(R.string.race_sprint_short);
                case "QUALIFYING": return res.getString(R.string.race_qualifying_short);
                case "RACE": return res.getString(R.string.race_race_short);
                default: return name;
            }
        }
    }

    static final class Race {
        final int round;
        final String name;
        final String place;
        /** In start order; the last one is the race. */
        final List<Session> sessions;

        Race(int round, String name, String place, List<Session> sessions) {
            this.round = round;
            this.name = name;
            this.place = place;
            List<Session> sorted = new ArrayList<>(sessions);
            sorted.sort((a, b) -> a.start.compareTo(b.start));
            this.sessions = Collections.unmodifiableList(sorted);
        }

        /** "United States Grand Prix" becomes "United States GP", which fits the panel's top line. */
        String shortName() {
            return name.replace("Grand Prix", "GP").trim();
        }
    }

    /** What the panel shows at one moment of a race weekend. */
    static final class State {
        final Race race;
        /** One per session of {@link #race}, same order. */
        final List<Status> statuses;
        /** The session on track now, or null. */
        final Session live;
        /** The next session to start, or null once the race has started. */
        final Session next;
        /** Time until {@link #next} starts; null when there is no next session. */
        final Duration untilNext;

        State(Race race, List<Status> statuses, Session live, Session next, Duration untilNext) {
            this.race = race;
            this.statuses = Collections.unmodifiableList(statuses);
            this.live = live;
            this.next = next;
            this.untilNext = untilNext;
        }

        /** The race is over and the panel is only showing the weekend until {@link #TAIL} runs out. */
        boolean finished() {
            return live == null && next == null;
        }
    }

    private RaceWeekend() {
    }

    /** The weekend {@code now} falls in, or null when no race is near. */
    static State at(List<Race> calendar, Instant now) {
        for (Race race : calendar) {
            if (race.sessions.isEmpty()) continue;
            Instant opens = race.sessions.get(0).start.minus(LEAD);
            Instant closes = race.sessions.get(race.sessions.size() - 1).start.plus(TAIL);
            if (now.isBefore(opens) || !now.isBefore(closes)) continue;

            List<Status> statuses = new ArrayList<>();
            Session live = null, next = null;
            for (Session s : race.sessions) {
                if (now.isBefore(s.start)) {
                    statuses.add(next == null ? Status.NEXT : Status.LATER);
                    if (next == null) next = s;
                } else if (now.isBefore(s.start.plus(s.length()))) {
                    statuses.add(Status.LIVE);
                    live = s;
                } else {
                    statuses.add(Status.DONE);
                }
            }
            return new State(race, statuses, live, next, next == null ? null : Duration.between(now, next.start));
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * "42 min", "2h 14m", "1d 3h". Rounded up to the minute, so a session 20 seconds away still reads
     * "1 min" and the countdown never says 0 before the session is live.
     */
    static String countdown(Resources res, Duration d) {
        long minutes = Math.max(1, (d.getSeconds() + 59) / 60);
        if (minutes < 60) return res.getString(R.string.race_countdown_minutes, minutes);
        long hours = minutes / 60;
        if (hours < 24) return res.getString(R.string.race_countdown_hours, hours, minutes % 60);
        return res.getString(R.string.race_countdown_days, hours / 24, hours % 24);
    }
}
